name: 朝日さざ波温泉
location: 富山県 下新川郡朝日町
sales_point: ヒスイの原石が拾えるというヒスイ海岸の近くに湧出した温泉。海岸を一望できる露天風呂が好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located near the Jade Coast, known for its jade stones. The open-air bath offers a great view of the coastline.

name: 阿曽原（黒部峡谷）温泉
sales_point: 黒部峡谷の深部、Ｓ字峡・十字峡・白竜峡などの近くに位置する温泉地。黒部峡谷を見下ろす台地に宿、河畔に露天風呂がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located deep in Kurobe Gorge, near S-curve Gorge, Cross Gorge, and White Dragon Gorge. It features accommodations on a plateau overlooking the gorge and an open-air bath by the river.

name: 雨晴温泉
sales_point: 富山湾を望む雨晴海岸に面した温泉地。能登半島や、立山連峰を遠望できる風光明媚な環境。海水浴客に好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing Amihara Beach, with views of Toyama Bay, the Noto Peninsula, and the Tateyama mountain range, making it a scenic spot popular with beachgoers.

name: アローザ温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ福光駅南西、医王山東側山麓に位置する温泉地。イオックスアローザスキー場の中で、冬はスキー客で大いに賑わう。
sales_point_en: Located southwest of JR Fukumi Station, at the eastern foot of Mount Iou. It is bustling with skiers in winter, as it is situated within the Iox Aroza Ski Resort.

name: 粟巣野温泉
sales_point: 鍬崎山北西側山麓、立山駅の南に位置する温泉地。春から秋はアルペンルート観光、冬はスキー場として一年中賑わいを見せている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northwest foot of Kuwasaki Mountain, south of Tateyama Station. It is lively year-round, with alpine route tourism in spring and autumn, and skiing in winter.

name: いかはまの湯温泉
sales_point: 県民公園頼成の森の西部に位置する温泉地。ＪＲ砺波駅からもインターチェンジからも近く、交通の便がよい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the western part of Kenmin Park Rainari no Mori. It is conveniently close to JR Toni Station and the interchange.

name: 五十里温泉
sales_point: 二上山の山麓に位置する温泉地。二上山公園は紅葉の名所で知られている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Fujikawa. The nearby Fujikawa Park is known for its beautiful autumn foliage.

name: 生地温泉
sales_point: 黒部川が富山湾に注ぐ河口近くに位置する温泉地。全国名水百選の黒部川扇状地湧水群が近くにあり、富山湾の幸を堪能できる。夏場は海水浴やキャンプを楽しむ人々で賑わう。
sales_point_en: Located near the mouth of the Kurobe River, where it flows into Toyama Bay. Close to the nationally selected Kurobe River spring water group, it offers a chance to enjoy the bounty of Toyama Bay. It is bustling with beachgoers and campers in summer.

name: 生地第一温泉
sales_point: 黒部川が富山湾に注ぐ河口近くに位置する温泉地。全国名水百選の黒部川扇状地湧水群が近くにあり、富山湾の幸を堪能できる。夏場は海水浴やキャンプを楽しむ人々で賑わう。
sales_point_en: Located near the mouth of the Kurobe River, where it flows into Toyama Bay. Close to the nationally selected Kurobe River spring water group, it offers a chance to enjoy the bounty of Toyama Bay. It is bustling with beachgoers and campers in summer.

name: 岩井戸（氷見温泉郷）
sales_point: 富山湾に面した温泉地。夜は漁火、朝は日の出、雪を被った立山連峰を富山湾越しに望む眺めは雄大で壮快。送迎有り。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing Toyama Bay. The view of fishing lights at night, sunrises in the morning, and the snow-capped Tateyama mountain range across the bay is magnificent and refreshing. Shuttle service available.

name: 牛岳温泉
sales_point: 平成元年に新しく掘削した温泉地。日帰り利用の健康センターもあり、のんびりくつろげる。スキー場ロッジにも引湯し、新保養地として人気。
sales_point_en: A newly developed hot spring area since 1989. It features a health center for day-use, allowing for relaxation. The hot spring water is also supplied to a ski lodge, making it a popular retreat.

name: 宇奈月温泉
sales_point: 富山県下最大の温泉地。日本最大のＶ字峡と言われる黒部峡谷の玄関口で自然環境がよい。北陸の代表的な観光温泉地で一年中賑わう。富山湾の海の幸が味わえる。
sales_point_en: The largest hot spring area in Toyama Prefecture. It serves as the gateway to Kurobe Gorge, known as Japan's largest V-shaped gorge, and offers a great natural environment. It is a representative tourist hot spring area in Hokuriku, bustling year-round, with the chance to enjoy the seafood of Toyama Bay.

name: 栄和（氷見温泉郷）
sales_point: 氷見阿尾の浦温泉に隣接している温泉地。やはり阿尾漁港でとれる魚は絶品。送迎有り。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area adjacent to Himi Aou no Ura Onsen. The fish caught at Aou Port is also exquisite. Shuttle service available.

name: 越中五箇山小瀬羽馬温泉
sales_point: 合掌造りと民謡・民話の里、上平村に位置する温泉地。霊峰人形山の北西側山麓、四季の移ろい豊かな山里にあり、心と体を癒すのに最適。
sales_point_en: Located in the village of Kamihirakawa, known for its gassho-zukuri architecture and folk songs and tales. Nestled at the northwest foot of the sacred Mount Ningyo, it is a perfect place to heal both mind and body amidst the rich seasonal changes.

name: 越中八尾温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ越中八尾駅の南西に位置する温泉地。町の中心に近い井田川沿いにある。富山藩主前田利保が山吹清水と命名して以来という歴史の永い所。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located southwest of JR Etchu Yatsuo Station, along the Ida River, close to the town center. It has a long history since it was named Yamabuki Shimizu by the lord of the Toyama domain, Maeda Toshiyasu.

name: 大牧温泉
sales_point: 小牧ダムの上流、庄川沿いに位置する温泉地。交通手段は遊覧船だけという秘境。紅葉が見事。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located upstream of Komaki Dam, along the Shogawa River. It is a hidden gem accessible only by sightseeing boat. The autumn foliage is stunning.

name: 小川温泉
location: 富山県 下新川郡朝日町
sales_point: 朝日ICからも近くアクセスに便利な温泉地。浴場からは日本海が一望でき、眺望が良い。小川温泉元湯から引湯している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area conveniently located near Asahi IC. The bathhouse offers a panoramic view of the Japan Sea.

name: 小川温泉元湯温泉
location: 富山県 下新川郡朝日町
sales_point: 白馬岳・朝日岳の麓に位置する温泉地。天然洞窟露天風呂が名物。400年の歴史を持つ名湯で、胃腸や子宝の湯としても知られている。湯治もできる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Hakuba and Mount Asahi. The natural cave open-air bath is a specialty. It has a history of 400 years and is known for its healing properties for the stomach and fertility.

name: 音川温泉
sales_point: 遠方に立山連峰を望み、富山市や日本海を一望にする大自然の中に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated in a natural setting with views of the distant Tateyama mountain range, Toyama City, and the Japan Sea. It is ideal for recuperation and therapy in a tranquil environment.

name: 春日温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ笹津駅の西、神通川に面した春日公園内に位置する温泉地。緑と水の豊かな環境で、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located in Kasuga Park, facing the Jinzū River, west of JR Sasatsu Station. It is a hot spring area in a rich environment of greenery and water, suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: 鐘釣温泉
sales_point: 黒部渓谷内に位置する温泉地。黒部川の河原の砂底から湧き出る露天風呂は胸までの深さがあり、野趣豊か。渓谷美が絶景。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located within the Kurobe Gorge. The outdoor bath, fed by springs from the sandy riverbed of the Kurobe River, is deep enough to reach the chest and offers a rich natural experience. The beauty of the gorge is breathtaking.

name: 亀谷温泉
sales_point: 常願寺川の支流、和田川沿いに位置する温泉地。有峰湖観光や立山登山の基地に最適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along the Wada River, a tributary of the Joganji River. It is an ideal base for sightseeing at Lake Atumi and climbing Mount Tateyama.

name: 川合田温泉
sales_point: 国道304号線沿い、桑山の裾に位置する温泉地。桑山や医王山からは富山湾や能登半島までが一望できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along National Route 304, at the foot of Kuwayama. From Kuwayama and Mount Iou, you can enjoy a panoramic view of Toyama Bay and the Noto Peninsula.

name: 金太郎温泉
sales_point: 片貝川沿いの天神山の麓に位置する温泉地。湯量豊富。客室からは富山湾や立山連峰が一望できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the foot of Tenjinyama along the Katakai River. It has abundant hot water, and the guest rooms offer a stunning view of Toyama Bay and the Tateyama mountain range.

name: 九殿浜（氷見温泉郷）
sales_point: 九殿浜に近接した所に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、眺望が良い。送迎有り。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located near Kudohama. It is blessed with a natural environment and offers great views. Shuttle service is available.

name: 呉羽山温泉
sales_point: 日本三霊山のひとつ、立山信仰文化が今に伝わる温泉地。湯は肌がつるつるし、効能が高いと言われる美人の湯。
sales_point_en: A hot spring that carries on the cultural belief of Mount Tateyama, one of Japan's three sacred mountains. The water is said to make the skin smooth and is known as a beauty hot spring with high efficacy.

name: 黒薙（黒部峡谷）温泉
sales_point: 黒部峡谷の温泉群の入口に位置する温泉地。峡谷沿いの露天風呂は野趣満点。宇奈月温泉の源泉となっている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the entrance of the hot springs in Kurobe Gorge. The outdoor baths along the gorge are full of natural charm. It is the source of Unazuki Onsen.

name: 黒部川明日温泉
sales_point: 黒部川の下流、平野に位置する温泉地。黒部市、魚津市、富山市方面観光にも便利、もちろん黒部峡谷探勝にも良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the plains downstream of the Kurobe River. It is convenient for sightseeing in Kurobe City, Uozu City, and Toyama City, and is also great for exploring Kurobe Gorge.

name: 桑の院鉱泉（氷見温泉郷）
sales_point: 氷見市の西部、桑の院地区に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養に好適。送迎有り。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the Kuwa no In area in the western part of Himi City. It is suitable for recuperation in a quiet environment. Shuttle service is available.

name: 五箇山温泉
sales_point: 平家落人の里の伝説を秘めた五箇山に位置する温泉地。合掌造りの民家の集落の里としても有名。露天風呂があり、五箇山観光の拠点として親しまれている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in Gokayama, which is steeped in legends of the Heike clan. It is also famous as a village of gassho-zukuri houses. With outdoor baths, it is a popular base for Gokayama sightseeing.

name: 境鉱泉
location: 富山県 下新川郡朝日町
sales_point: 国道8号線沿いに位置する温泉地。目の前に日本海が広がる眺望の良いところで、湯治場として有名である。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along National Route 8. It offers a great view of the Sea of Japan right in front and is famous as a hot spring for recuperation.

name: 桜ヶ池温泉
sales_point: 城端町西部、桜ヶ池の北岸に位置する温泉地。木々に囲まれた閑静な環境で湖の景観と森林浴がくつろぎを与えてくれる。桜の時期は特に美しい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on the northern shore of Sakuragaike in the western part of Jounan Town. Surrounded by trees, it provides a tranquil environment for relaxation, with beautiful lake views and forest bathing, especially stunning during cherry blossom season.

name: 指崎（氷見温泉郷）
sales_point: 阿尾漁港の北西部、指崎に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。阿尾川河畔に有り、自然環境が良い。送迎有り。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in Yubizaki, northwest of Ao Port. It is situated along the banks of the Ao River, in a good natural environment. Shuttle service is available.

name: 三協アルミまんよう荘温泉
sales_point: 小矢部川のほとりに位置する温泉地。企業の保養施設となっているが一般にも開放している。富山、氷見観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located by the banks of the Oyabe River. Although it is a corporate resort facility, it is open to the public. It is a suitable base for sightseeing in Toyama and Himi.

name: 下の茗温泉
sales_point: 室牧川沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、休養・保養に好適。川のせせらぎを聞きながらくつろげる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along the Muromaki River. It is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for rest and recuperation. You can relax while listening to the murmuring of the river.

name: 庄川温泉郷
sales_point: 庄川沿いに位置する温泉郷。青々とした庄川の流れに沿って趣のある温泉宿が点在し、ゆったりと湯けむりに包まれる。庄川峡探勝基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring village located along the Shogawa River. Quaint hot spring inns are scattered along the lush flow of the Shogawa, allowing you to relax in the soothing hot spring mist. It is a great base for exploring the Shogawa Gorge.

name: 新鐘釣温泉
sales_point: 黒部峡谷の奥深くに位置する温泉地。宿から渓谷を10メートルほど下った所に露天風呂がある。夏でも雪渓を見ることができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located deep in the Kurobe Gorge. The outdoor bath is situated about 10 meters down the valley from the inn, where you can see snowfields even in summer.

name: 地獄谷温泉
location: 富山県 中新川郡立山町
sales_point: 標高2400メートル、地獄谷を見下ろせる日本で一番高所の温泉地。神秘的なみくりが池の湖畔に位置し、雄大な立山連峰が望める秘湯。付近には天然記念物に指定されている雷鳥が生息している。
sales_point_en: The highest hot spring in Japan, located at an elevation of 2400 meters, overlooking Jigokudani. It is a mystical hot spring located by the shores of the beautiful Mikurigaike, with a magnificent view of the Tateyama mountain range. The area is home to the natural monument, the rock ptarmigan.

name: 城川原化石温泉
sales_point: 神通川の河口近くに位置する温泉地。中島大橋のたもとにある総合レジャーランドとなっている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located near the mouth of the Jinzū River. It is part of a comprehensive leisure land at the foot of Nakajima Ohashi.

name: 仙人湯（黒部峡谷）温泉
sales_point: 黒部峡谷の深部の仙人谷沿いに位置する温泉地。駅からは徒歩でしかたどり着けない秘湯。剱岳土山基地に最適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along the secluded Sennin Valley in the depths of Kurobe Gorge. It can only be reached on foot from the nearest station, making it a hidden gem. It is ideal for the base of climbing Mount Tsurugi.

name: 太閤山温泉
sales_point: 豊臣秀吉ゆかりの太閤山の丘陵地に位置する温泉地。霊泉として珍重されてきた歴史を持つ。東方に立山連峰を望むことができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the hilly area of Taikoyama, associated with Toyotomi Hideyoshi. It has a history of being cherished as a sacred spring and offers views of the Tateyama mountain range to the east.

name: 高窪温泉
sales_point: 福光駅の北西11キロ、石川県境近くに位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located 11 kilometers northwest of Fukumi Station, near the Ishikawa Prefecture border. It is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 高天原温泉
sales_point: 北アルプスの真ん中、黒部川の上流沿いに位置する温泉地。水晶岳と雪ノ平に挟まれた岩苔小谷にある。露天風呂からは四方囲まれたアルプスの山々を眺めることができる。徒歩で折立から２日要するため、夏期のみの営業。
sales_point_en: Situated in the heart of the Northern Alps along the upper reaches of the Kurobe River, this hot spring is nestled in the rocky valley between Suishodake and Yukinodaira. The open-air bath offers views of the surrounding Alpine mountains, accessible only in summer as it takes two days to walk from Oritate.

name: たから温泉
location: 富山県 下新川郡朝日町
sales_point: ヒスイの原石が拾えるというヒスイ海岸の近くに湧出した温泉。日本海を望む眺望の良さが人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring that springs near the jade coast, known for its jade stone picking. It is popular for its excellent views of the Japan Sea.

name: 竹原の湯（氷見温泉郷）
sales_point: 氷見温泉郷の中で最南端に位置する温泉地。国道160号線沿いで交通の便が良い。送迎有り。
sales_point_en: The southernmost hot spring in the Himi Onsen area, conveniently located along National Route 160. Shuttle service is available.

name: 寺尾温泉
sales_point: 谷内川沿いに位置する温泉地。宿からは付近の山々が一望できる。日本海の新鮮な魚介類が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located along the Yachikawa River, this hot spring offers a panoramic view of the nearby mountains. Enjoy fresh seafood from the Japan Sea.

name: 天神山温泉
sales_point: 魚津市と日本海を望み、背後には立山連峰を仰ぐ風光明媚な環境にある。片貝川沿いの台地に位置する温泉地。宿の前にブドウ園が広がっている。
sales_point_en: Set in a picturesque environment overlooking Uozu City and the Japan Sea, with the Tateyama mountain range behind. The hot spring is located on a plateau along the Katakai River, with a vineyard spread out in front of the inn.

name: 利賀そばの郷温泉
sales_point: 近くにそばの郷があり、そばに関する資料館やそば屋が3軒ある。
sales_point_en: Nearby is a soba village with a museum and three soba restaurants.

name: 床鍋鉱泉（氷見温泉郷）
sales_point: 氷見市の西部、床鍋地区に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養に好適。送迎有り。
sales_point_en: Located in the western part of Himi City, in the Tokonabe area. It is a quiet environment suitable for recuperation. Shuttle service is available.

name: 礪波リゾート温泉
sales_point: いかはまの湯の南西、砺波市郊外に位置する温泉地。市の特産品はチューリップと球根で、「道の駅となみ」はフラワーランドとなっており、美しい花を眺めることができる。
sales_point_en: Located southwest of Ikahama no Yu, this hot spring is on the outskirts of Tono City. The city is known for its tulips and bulbs, and the 'Michi no Eki Tona' features a flower land where beautiful flowers can be enjoyed.

name: 富山福岡家族村温泉
sales_point: 子撫川の上流沿いに位置する温泉地。キャンプ場の他、家族で楽しめるさまざまなスポーツ施設がある。また町には鯉の養殖地としても知られており、鯉料理が人気。
sales_point_en: Situated along the upper reaches of the Konukawa River, this hot spring features a campsite and various sports facilities for family enjoyment. The town is also known for koi farming, and koi dishes are popular.

name: 鯰温泉
sales_point: 神通川河口近くの富山湾沿いに位置する温泉地。田園風景の中にあり、のどかな環境。岩瀬浜、八重津浜、とやまサンビーチの海水浴客で夏場賑わう。
sales_point_en: Located along Toyama Bay near the mouth of the Jinzugawa River, this hot spring is set in a rural landscape, providing a tranquil environment. It is bustling with beachgoers in summer at Iwasehama, Yaetsuhama, and Toyama Sun Beach.

name: 鯰第一温泉
sales_point: 八重津浜南方、富山湾沿いに位置する温泉地。田園風景の中にある富山湾の海の幸を堪能できる。海水浴客、家族連れに好評。
sales_point_en: Located along Toyama Bay south of Yaetsuhama, this hot spring allows guests to enjoy the seafood of Toyama Bay amidst a rural landscape. It is popular among beachgoers and families.

name: ハートピア富山つるぎ温泉
location: 富山県 中新川郡上市町
sales_point: 北アルプスの名峰剱岳を一望できる上市町に位置する温泉地。温かな日だまりのようなリゾート空間で、お湯と、味と、眺めで疲れた心と体をほんわかと、心地よいくつろぎのひとときを過ごすことができる。
sales_point_en: Located in Kamiichi Town, offering a view of the famous peak Tsurugi-dake in the Northern Alps. It provides a warm, sunny resort atmosphere where guests can relax and enjoy the hot springs, cuisine, and views.

name: 祖母谷（黒部峡谷）温泉
sales_point: 紅葉の名所猿飛峡の東方約1.5キロに位置する温泉地。祖母谷と祖父谷の出会う川原に面している。白馬岳、唐松岳登山基地としても利用されている。源泉は祖母谷温泉地獄と呼ばれる。
sales_point_en: Located about 1.5 kilometers east of the famous autumn foliage spot Sarutobikyo, this hot spring faces the river where Obogatani and Sobogatani meet. It is also used as a base for climbing Hakuba-dake and Karasumayama. The source is known as Obogatani Onsen Jigoku.

name: 氷見阿尾の浦（氷見温泉郷）
sales_point: 富山湾きっての漁港、氷見の阿尾漁港のすぐ近くに位置する温泉地。立山連峰や漁火を一望でき、眺望は抜群。魚と温泉を堪能できる。送迎有り。
sales_point_en: Located very close to Aonoura Fishing Port, one of the best fishing ports in Toyama Bay. It offers excellent views of the Tateyama mountain range and fishing lights, allowing guests to enjoy both seafood and hot springs. Shuttle service is available.

name: 氷見灘浦（氷見温泉郷）
sales_point: 岩井戸温泉の南方すぐに位置する温泉地。風光明媚な環境で保養に好適。送迎有り。
sales_point_en: Located just south of Iwaido Onsen, this hot spring is in a picturesque environment suitable for recuperation. Shuttle service is available.

name: 氷見松田江（氷見温泉郷）
sales_point: 日本の水浴場55選に選ばれた松田江浜海水浴場がすぐ目の前という温泉地。海浜植物園やキャンプ場も近接している。送迎有り。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is right in front of Matsudae Beach, selected as one of Japan's top 55 bathing beaches. A coastal botanical garden and campsite are also nearby. Shuttle service is available.

name: 福光温泉
sales_point: 医王山南東側山麓に位置する温泉地。小矢部川沿いにあり、上流7キロに紅葉の名所、小矢部峡がある。
sales_point_en: Located at the southeastern foot of Mount Iou, this hot spring is along the Oyabe River, with the famous autumn foliage spot Oyabe Gorge located 7 kilometers upstream.

name: ふくみつ華山温泉
sales_point: 医王山の懐に抱かれた温泉地。北アルプス立山連峰を遠望できる山里にある。
sales_point_en: Nestled in the embrace of Mount Iou, this hot spring is located in a mountain village with distant views of the Northern Alps.

name: 法林寺温泉
sales_point: 医王山の北東側山麓、吉谷川の谷内に位置する温泉地。湯量が豊富で効能も高く、静養客が多く利用している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northeastern foothills of Mount Iō, in the valley of Yoshitani River. It has abundant hot water and high efficacy, making it popular among those seeking relaxation.

name: みのわ温泉
sales_point: 早月川畔に位置する温泉地。みのわテニス村内にある健康休養施設。ハイキングや釣りなども楽しめる。家族連れにも好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the banks of Hayatsuki River. It is a health and relaxation facility within Minowa Tennis Village, offering hiking and fishing, and is well-received by families.

name: 宮島温泉
sales_point: 小矢部市北部、子撫川沿いに位置する温泉地。豊かな自然と数々の伝説を持つ、宮島の川辺の宿。そばに一の滝、二の滝があり、秋には九離縁も開園する。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Oyabe City, along the Konabe River. It is a riverside inn with rich nature and numerous legends, close to the First and Second Waterfalls, and opens in autumn for the Kyu-Rien.

name: 名剣（黒部峡谷）温泉
sales_point: 黒部峡谷の祖母谷川沿いに位置する温泉地。黒部峡谷鉄道の終点、欅平駅から歩いて約15分にある一軒宿の秘湯。渓谷沿いに自然を活かした露天風呂があり、人気がある。登山や黒部峡谷探勝基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Obogatani River in Kurobe Gorge. It is a hidden inn about a 15-minute walk from the end of the Kurobe Gorge Railway at Keyakidaira Station, featuring outdoor baths that utilize the natural surroundings, popular for hiking and as a base for exploring Kurobe Gorge.

name: 山田温泉
sales_point: 山田川に沿いに位置する温泉地。歴史の永い北陸の名湯。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yamada River. It is a historic famous hot spring in Hokuriku.

name: 湯神子温泉
location: 富山県 中新川郡上市町
sales_point: 大岩川支流の須山川沿いに位置する温泉地。大岩川上流にある日石寺境内には飛竜峡とよばれる奇岩、怪石が見られる。町の南端には日本100名山の剱岳や奥大日岳がそびえ立つ。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Suyama River, a tributary of the Oikawa River. The grounds of Nichisekiji Temple upstream feature strange rocks known as Hiryū Gorge. The southern end of the town is dominated by the 100 Famous Mountains of Japan, including Mount Tsurugi and Mount Okudainichi.

name: 林道温泉
sales_point: 高清水山北西側山麓に位置する温泉地。足を伸ばすと周囲にはスキー場や紅葉の名所なども多く、また福光ICからも近いことから観光の足場に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northwestern foothills of Takashimizu Mountain. It is close to ski resorts and famous autumn foliage spots, making it a suitable base for tourism, and is also near Fukumi IC.

name: 青木温泉
sales_point: 小武川の上流、標高1150メートルに位置する温泉地。鳳凰三山の登山口として親しまれている。湯来に閉ざされる11月下旬から４月下旬間では休業。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located upstream of the Kobu River at an elevation of 1,150 meters. It is well-known as a trailhead for climbing the Phoenix Three Mountains. It is closed from late November to late April due to heavy snowfall.

name: 赤石温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡増穂町
sales_point: 櫛形山の山麓、戸川渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foothills of Kushigata Mountain, along the Togawa Valley. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: 芦安温泉
location: 山梨県 南アルプス
sales_point: 夜叉神峠の山麓、御勅使川沿いに位置する温泉地。南アルプス林道へ続く道に宿が点在し、大自然の中で温泉を満喫できる。夜叉神峠や白鳳渓谷探勝基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foothills of Yashajintōge, along the Omochishi River. Inns are scattered along the road leading to the South Alps Forest Road, allowing guests to enjoy hot springs in the great outdoors. It is ideal for exploring Yashajintōge and Hakuhō Valley.

name: 穴山温泉
sales_point: 七里岩の高台に位置する温泉地。南アルプスや八ヶ岳の眺望が良い。閑静な環境にあり、休養・保養に好適。釣りやゴルフなども楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a high ground of Nanashiri Rock. It offers great views of the South Alps and Yatsugatake. In a quiet environment, it is suitable for relaxation and recuperation, with opportunities for fishing and golfing.

name: 天科（三富温泉郷）
sales_point: 笛吹川上流の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。三富温泉郷の一つに数えられる。広瀬ダムにも近く、湖畔には公園やふるさと記念館がある。西沢渓谷観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the valley upstream of Fuefuki River. It is one of the Mitsutomi Onsen Districts, close to Hirose Dam, with parks and a hometown memorial museum by the lakeside. It is a suitable base for exploring Nishizawa Valley.

name: 石和温泉
sales_point: 昭和36年にぶどう畑の中に湧出した温泉。行楽と保養が混在している県下最大の温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring that emerged in 1961 amidst vineyards. It is the largest hot spring area in the prefecture, combining leisure and recuperation.

name: 一の橋（三富温泉郷）
sales_point: 笛吹川上流の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。三富温泉郷の一つに数えられる。徳和渓谷観光、乾徳山登山の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the valley upstream of Fuefuki River. It is one of the Mitsutomi Onsen Districts, making it a suitable base for exploring Tokuwa Valley and climbing Dryoku Mountain.

name: 岩下温泉
sales_point: 兜山山麓のブドウ畑の中に位置する温泉地。開湯は1700年と伝えられ、甲州最古の温泉といわれている。閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。甲斐路の味覚を堪能できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located among vineyards at the foothills of Kabuto Mountain. It is said to have opened in 1700, making it the oldest hot spring in Koshu. In a quiet environment, it is suitable for recuperation and relaxation, allowing guests to enjoy the flavors of the Kai region.

name: 内船温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡身延町
sales_point: ＪＲ内船駅の北東1.5キロ、思親山の南西側山麓に位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にある。近くに東海自然歩道が通り、ハイキングや、登山者の拠点に最適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 1.5 kilometers northeast of JR Uchifune Station, at the southwestern foothills of Shishinzan. It is in a quiet mountain environment, with the Tokai Nature Trail nearby, making it ideal for hiking and as a base for climbers.

name: 塩山温泉
sales_point: 昔、食塩を産したといわれる塩山の山麓に位置する温泉地。歴史が古く、静かな環境で、保養に適している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foothills of Yōzan, which is said to have produced salt in the past. It has a long history and is in a quiet environment, making it suitable for recuperation.

name: 忍野温泉
location: 山梨県 南都留郡忍野村
sales_point: 桂川の河畔に位置する温泉地。巨峰・富士山の眺望が良い。河口湖、山中湖、富士山の観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the banks of the Katsura River, offering great views of Mount Fuji and the giant grapes. It is a suitable base for exploring Lake Kawaguchi, Lake Yamanaka, and Mount Fuji.

name: 春日居温泉
sales_point: 周囲を果樹園に囲まれた明るい雰囲気の温泉地。石和温泉と隣接している。
sales_point_en: A bright hot spring area surrounded by orchards. It is adjacent to Isawa Onsen.

name: 金山鉱泉
sales_point: 大月駅の西北側8キロ桂川の支流、金山川河畔に位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。登山客にも人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 8 kilometers northwest of Ōtsuki Station, along the banks of Kanayama River, a tributary of Katsura River. It is in a quiet mountain environment, suitable for recuperation and relaxation, and is popular among climbers.

name: 神の湯温泉
sales_point: 貢川沿いの高台に位置する温泉地。周囲は田園に囲まれた閑静な環境で、保養・休養に好適。富士山と甲府盆地の眺望が良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a high ground along the Kou River. Surrounded by tranquil rural scenery, it is ideal for relaxation and recuperation, offering great views of Mount Fuji and the Kofu Basin.

name: 茅の湯温泉
sales_point: 南アルプスの眺望が良い温泉地。日帰りの入浴施設が併設されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with great views of the Southern Alps. It features facilities for day-use bathing.

name: 川浦（三富温泉郷）
sales_point: 笛吹川上流の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。三富温泉郷の一つに数えられる。奥秩父の秘境と言われる西沢渓谷観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located along the upstream of the Fuefuki River, this hot spring area is one of the Mitomi Onsen Districts. It serves as a great base for exploring the Nishizawa Valley, known as a hidden gem of the Okuchichibu region.

name: 草塩温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡早川町
sales_point: 早川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。「モクゲンジ」の群落の中にある。笊ヶ岳登山基地や森林浴に最適。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Hayakawa Valley, this hot spring area is nestled within a grove of 'Mokugenji' trees. It is ideal for mountain climbing and forest bathing.

name: 黒森温泉
sales_point: 山梨県最北端、信州峠南側に位置する温泉地。瑞牆山の眺望も良く、登山基地にも好適。
sales_point_en: Located at the northernmost point of Yamanashi Prefecture, south of the Shinshu Pass, this hot spring area offers great views of Mount Mizugaki and is suitable as a base for mountain climbing.

name: 幸福温泉
sales_point: 鳳凰三山や会駒ヶ岳を仰ぐ国道20号線沿いに位置する温泉地。前には釜無川の広い河原が広がり、後ろは七里ヶ岩の断崖が続く。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located along National Route 20, overlooking the Phoenix Three Mountains and Kaikoma Mountain. In front, there is a wide riverbed of the Kamanasu River, and behind it, the cliffs of Nanashiri Rock continue.

name: 甲府（市内）温泉
sales_point: 山梨県の県庁所在地である甲府の中心地に位置する温泉地。湯はなめらかで肌触りも良い。ビジネスにも便利。
sales_point_en: Located in the center of Kofu, the capital of Yamanashi Prefecture, this hot spring area features smooth water that feels great on the skin. It is also convenient for business travelers.

name: 小淵沢温泉
sales_point: 小淵沢ICの東方約2キロ地点に位置する温泉地。地下1500メートルから湧き出す温泉を利用した日帰り入浴施設が併設されている。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located about 2 kilometers east of Kobuchizawa IC. It features a day-use bathing facility utilizing hot spring water that springs from 1500 meters underground.

name: 御座石温泉
sales_point: 小武川湯沢渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。標高1117メートルの高所にある温泉。鳳凰連山の登山基地にも好適。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Kobu River and Yuzawa Valley, this hot spring is located at an elevation of 1117 meters. It is also suitable as a base for climbing the Phoenix Mountain Range.

name: 裂石温泉
sales_point: 大菩薩峠の登山口近くに位置する温泉地。巨石を組み上げた野趣豊かな露天風呂がある。馬刺、煮貝などの甲州名物が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located near the trailhead of the Daibosatsu Pass, this hot spring area features a rustic open-air bath made of large stones. Visitors can enjoy local specialties such as horse sashimi and boiled shellfish.

name: 笹子鉱泉
sales_point: 笹子トンネル入口近くの笹子川沿いに位置する温泉地。国道20号線沿いにあり、勝沼、山梨方面からのアクセスが便利。山菜取りや渓流釣りを楽しむことが出来る。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located along the Sasako River near the entrance of the Sasako Tunnel. It is conveniently accessible from National Route 20, making it easy to reach from Katsunuma and Yamanashi. Visitors can enjoy mountain vegetable picking and stream fishing.

name: 佐野川温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡身延町
sales_point: 静岡県境近く、富士川支流の佐野川沿いに位置する温泉地。谷川のせせらぎを聞きながら、庭園風露天風呂からの桜や紅葉は絶景。県内外の人々で賑わいを見せている。
sales_point_en: Located near the Shizuoka Prefecture border along the Sanogawa River, this hot spring area offers a beautiful view of cherry blossoms and autumn leaves from its garden-style open-air bath, accompanied by the sound of the flowing stream. It attracts many visitors from both inside and outside the prefecture.

name: 三条の湯温泉
location: 山梨県 北都留郡丹波山村
sales_point: 雲取山中腹、標高約1100メートルに位置する温泉地。一軒宿の山の秘湯。主に雲取山などの登山客の利用が多く、個室はない。徒歩でしか到着できないので注意。
sales_point_en: Situated at an elevation of about 1100 meters on the slopes of Mount Kumotori, this hot spring area is a solitary inn. It is mainly frequented by climbers of Mount Kumotori, and there are no private rooms. Note that it can only be accessed on foot.

name: 塩沢温泉
sales_point: 南アルプスで最も北に位置する温泉地。登山客や地元客に好評。山々の緑に囲まれ、自然環境が良い。
sales_point_en: The northernmost hot spring area in the Southern Alps, it is popular among climbers and locals. Surrounded by lush green mountains, it offers a great natural environment.

name: 塩之沢温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡身延町
sales_point: 富士川支流の御持川沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located along the Omochi River, a tributary of the Fuji River, this hot spring area is in a quiet mountain setting, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 敷島温泉
sales_point: 茅ヶ岳南側山麓の亀沢地区に位置する温泉地。プール、テニス、ゴルフ場が完備されたスポーツリゾート温泉。
sales_point_en: Located in the Kamezawa area at the southern foot of Mount Chikuyō, this hot spring area is a sports resort with facilities for swimming, tennis, and golf.

name: 下部温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡身延町
sales_point: 富士川支流の下部川沿いに位置する温泉地。武田信玄が肩先の傷を治したと伝えられ、歴史が永い。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。飲泉もでき、温泉をミネラルウォーターとして販売している。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Shimobe River, a tributary of the Fuji River, this hot spring area has a long history, said to be where Takeda Shingen healed his shoulder wound. It is in a quiet environment, ideal for recuperation and therapy. Drinking the spring water is also possible, and it is sold as mineral water. It is a national health resort.

name: 昭和温泉
location: 山梨県 中巨摩郡昭和町
sales_point: 甲府市に隣接する昭和町に位置する温泉地。ICからも近く車の便がよい。甲府、山梨観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located in Showa Town, adjacent to Kofu City, this hot spring area is conveniently close to the IC, making it easy to access by car. It is a great base for sightseeing in Kofu and Yamanashi.

name: 十谷温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡鰍沢町
sales_point: 源氏渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。新緑や紅葉の頃は特に美しい。渓谷散策や釣りなどが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located along the Genji Valley, this hot spring area is particularly beautiful during the fresh green and autumn foliage seasons. Visitors can enjoy valley walks and fishing.

name: 十枚荘温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡身延町
sales_point: 十枚山の北東側山麓、戸栗川清流のほとりに位置する温泉地。静かにたたずむ一軒宿。豊かな自然に囲まれ、新鮮な山の幸と名物のいのしし料理を堪能できる。
sales_point_en: Situated on the northeastern foothills of Jumai Mountain, next to the clear stream of the Toguri River, this hot spring area features a quiet inn. Surrounded by rich nature, guests can enjoy fresh mountain delicacies and the local specialty of wild boar cuisine.

name: 須玉温泉
sales_point: 須玉IC近くに位置する温泉地。火山性岩屑流層から湧出するラジウム含有量東洋一の天然泉で、アトピーなどに特に良いと言われる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Sudama IC. It features the highest natural radium content in the East, sourced from volcanic rock debris, and is said to be particularly beneficial for conditions like atopy.

name: 積翠寺温泉
sales_point: 要害山の山麓に位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり、甲府市街地を見下ろし、眺望が良い。特に夜景が見事。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Yōgai. It offers a quiet environment with a great view overlooking Kofu city, especially stunning at night.

name: 鶴鉱泉
sales_point: 上野原駅近くの桂川沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にある。高柄山・大地峠などのハイキング基地にも好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Katsura River near Uenohara Station. It is situated in a tranquil mountain environment, making it a great base for hiking to Takagara Mountain and Daichi Pass.

name: 天目温泉
sales_point: 大菩薩嶺南側山麓、日川沿いに位置する温泉地。清流と緑あふれる閑静な環境にある。黒岳登山の基地にも好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Hikawa River at the southern foot of Mount Bōsatsu. It is in a serene environment filled with clear streams and greenery, making it suitable as a base for climbing Mount Kuro.

name: 常葉温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡身延町
sales_point: 下部町の町中に位置する温泉地。町の名産「ヤマメの里」が近くにあり、アウトドアを兼ねて楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the center of Shimobe Town. It is close to the local specialty 'Yamame no Sato', allowing for outdoor enjoyment.

name: 道志温泉
location: 山梨県 南都留郡道志村
sales_point: 道志渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。四方を山に囲まれた閑静な環境にあり、天狗岩、甲斐七滝などの見所が多い。山歩きや釣りなども楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Dōshi Valley. Surrounded by mountains, it offers a quiet environment with many attractions like Tengu Rock and the Kai Seven Waterfalls. Enjoy hiking and fishing as well.

name: 奈良田温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡早川町
sales_point: 南アルプス最奥に位置する温泉地。早川の白鳳渓谷に面して自然環境が良い1軒宿の秘湯。7つの効能を持つ温泉は美肌効果も高く、飲泉もできる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the far end of the Southern Alps. It is a hidden gem facing the Hakuhō Valley of Hayakawa, with a natural environment and a hot spring known for its seven health benefits, including skin beautification and drinking.

name: 西山温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡早川町
sales_point: 早川渓谷と湯川の合流点付近に位置する素朴な温泉地。下部と並び県内最古の湯と言われ1300年の歴史を持つ。自然環境に恵まれ、渓谷が美しい。
sales_point_en: A rustic hot spring area located near the confluence of the Hayakawa Valley and Yukawa. It is said to be one of the oldest hot springs in the prefecture, with a history of 1300 years, blessed with beautiful valley scenery.

name: 橋倉鉱泉
sales_point: ＪＲ大月駅の西北側6キロの山あいに位置する温泉地。戦国時代に開湯し、かつて鉱泉の奥の金鉱採掘者の療養場だったと伝えられる。現在は保養・登山の基地として親しまれている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 6 kilometers northwest of JR Ōtsuki Station in the mountains. It was opened during the Warring States period and is said to have been a healing place for gold miners. It is now popular as a base for relaxation and mountain climbing.

name: 初鹿野温泉
sales_point: 甲斐大和駅と国道20号線にはさまれた集落に位置する温泉地。高速ICから近く車の便が良い。周辺観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a village nestled between Kai Yamato Station and National Route 20. It is conveniently located near an expressway interchange, making it a great base for surrounding sightseeing.

name: 八田温泉
location: 山梨県 南アルプス
sales_point: 釜無川支流沿いに位置する温泉地。八田村北部の「ユーカリの里」の中にあり静かな環境。果物が美味。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along a tributary of the Kamanasu River. It is situated in a quiet environment within 'Eucalyptus Village' in the northern part of Hatta, known for its delicious fruits.

name: 広瀬（三富温泉郷）
sales_point: 笛吹川上流の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。三富温泉郷の一つに数えられる。一之釜遊歩道の中程にあり、西沢渓谷観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the upstream valley of the Fuefuki River. It is counted as one of the Mitsutomi Onsen Districts and is ideally located for sightseeing in the Nishizawa Valley, being midway along the Ichinokama Promenade.

name: 深沢温泉
sales_point: 大深沢川の谷間沿いに位置する温泉地。付近では山菜やキノコ狩りが楽しめる。閑静な環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the valley of the Ōfukasawa River. Nearby, visitors can enjoy mountain vegetable and mushroom picking. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 富士河口湖温泉郷
location: 山梨県 南都留郡富士河口湖町
sales_point: 富士五湖のひとつ、河口湖の湖畔に位置する温泉地。富士山の眺望が絶景。浴場から富士山や河口湖を見渡すことができる。
city_ja: 南都留郡富士河口湖町
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the shores of Lake Kawaguchi, one of the Fuji Five Lakes. It offers breathtaking views of Mount Fuji, with the hot spring baths providing a view of both Mount Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi.

name: 富士山温泉
location: 山梨県 富士吉田市
sales_point: 南に富士山を一望できる眺望の良い温泉地。露天風呂が完備されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with great views of Mount Fuji to the south. It features outdoor baths.

name: 船山温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡身延町
sales_point: 富士川の支流、船山川沿いに位置する温泉地。100年以上前から湯治場として賑わい、効能も高い。町は火祭りが有名で、山の幸やしし鍋が味わうことが出来る。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Funayama River, a tributary of the Fuji River. It has been a popular healing spot for over 100 years and is known for its high efficacy. The town is famous for its fire festival and offers local mountain delicacies and wild boar hot pot.

name: 真木温泉
sales_point: 真木川沿いに位置する温泉地。周囲を山と渓谷に囲まれた閑静な環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。山菜取りや釣りも楽しむことが出来る。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Maki River. It is surrounded by mountains and valleys, providing a quiet environment suitable for relaxation and recuperation. Visitors can also enjoy mountain vegetable picking and fishing.

name: 増富温泉
sales_point: 本谷川沿いに位置する温泉地。ラジウム含有量が世界有数で、温泉の効能が高いと伝えられる。自然環境豊かな山あいにあり、保養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Motani River. It is known for its world-class radium content and high efficacy, situated in a rich natural environment in the mountains, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation. It is a designated national health resort.

name: 身延温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡身延町
sales_point: 身延山久遠寺の門前町に位置する温泉地。身延山参拝客の利用が多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the town at the foot of Minobu Mountain, known for its proximity to the Kuon-ji Temple, attracting many visitors.

name: 桃の木温泉
location: 山梨県 南アルプス

name: 藪の湯温泉
sales_point: 甲斐駒ヶ岳山麓の大武川沿いに位置する温泉地。胃腸病の名湯として古くから知られる。甲斐駒ヶ岳から八ヶ岳まで山岳パノラマを満喫でき、特に冬の眺めは美しい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Ootake River at the foot of Mount Kaikomagatake, known for its therapeutic properties for gastrointestinal diseases. Enjoy a panoramic view of the mountains from Kaikomagatake to Yatsugatake, especially beautiful in winter.

name: 山中湖温泉
location: 山梨県 南都留郡山中湖村
sales_point: 富士五湖の中で最も大きな山中湖付近に位置する温泉地。四季を通じて様々な楽しみ方ができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Lake Yamanakako, the largest of the Fuji Five Lakes, offering various activities throughout the seasons.

name: 湯沢温泉
location: 山梨県 南巨摩郡身延町
sales_point: 常葉川沿いに位置する温泉地。歴史は永く、古くは表湯と呼ばれていた。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Tokoyagawa River, with a long history, formerly known as Omotoyu.

name: 湯村温泉
sales_point: 昇仙峡の入口で弘法大師が発見したと言われている、歴史の古い温泉地。武田信玄の隠し湯のひとつに数えられ、南アルプスの眺望が良い。
sales_point_en: An ancient hot spring area said to have been discovered by Kobo Daishi at the entrance of Shosenkyo Gorge. It is counted among Takeda Shingen's hidden hot springs and offers a great view of the Southern Alps.

name: 竜王温泉
sales_point: 釜無川の近くに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、釣り客や登山、観光客の利用が多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the Kamanasugawa River, in a quiet environment popular among fishermen, hikers, and tourists.

name: 相川長手岬温泉
sales_point: 佐渡七浦海岸の景勝地、長手岬に位置する温泉地。特に夕日の美しさで知られている。海中公園に指定されるほど海の透明度も高く、美しい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at Nagate Cape, a scenic spot on the Sado Nanau Coast, known for its beautiful sunsets. The water is so clear it has been designated as a marine park.

name: 愛鱗温泉
sales_point: 長岡駅の東方5キロに位置する温泉地。山菜・鯉料理で家庭的なおもてなしが好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 5 kilometers east of Nagaoka Station, well-known for its homey hospitality featuring wild vegetables and carp dishes.

name: 赤倉（妙高高原温泉郷）
sales_point: 妙高山中腹に位置する温泉地。妙高高原温泉郷最大の温泉地で日本最大級の野天風呂がある。冬はスキー客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the slopes of Mount Myoko, the largest in the Myoko Kogen Onsen area, featuring one of Japan's largest outdoor baths. It is bustling with skiers in winter.

name: 赤湯温泉
location: 新潟県 南魚沼郡湯沢町
sales_point: 徒歩でしか行けない秘湯。苗場山登山のベースとして、又秘湯を求める人々に人気がある。冬期は休業。
sales_point_en: A hidden hot spring accessible only on foot, popular as a base for climbing Mount Naeba and sought after by those looking for secret hot springs. Closed in winter.

name: アクアーレ長岡温泉
sales_point: 長岡ICの南西約5キロに位置する温泉地。プールやトレーニングジムも併設しており、明るい雰囲気で家族連れにも人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 5 kilometers southwest of Nagaoka IC, featuring a pool and training gym, popular among families for its bright atmosphere.

name: 朝日まほろば温泉
location: 新潟県 岩船郡朝日村
sales_point: 道の駅朝日に隣接する温泉地。物産会館・まゆ工房・温室ハウスなどがある。また、平成10年には、10種類の浴槽やプール・ウォータースライダーなどが完備された3世代交流型の施設もオープンしている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area adjacent to the Asahi Road Station, featuring a product hall, silk workshop, and greenhouse. In 1998, a facility with 10 types of baths, a pool, and water slides was opened for intergenerational interaction.

name: 畔地（六日町温泉郷）
sales_point: 五十沢温泉の東方1キロの地に新しく湧出した温泉地。東方に紅葉のメッカ十字峡があり、観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A newly emerged hot spring area located 1 kilometer east of Iizawaya Onsen. Nearby is the famous autumn foliage spot, Juji Gorge, making it a great base for sightseeing.

name: あてま温泉
sales_point: 当間川沿いに位置する温泉地。新しくオープンした施設充実のリゾート温泉。豊かな自然に包まれ落ち着いた環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Atama River, featuring a newly opened resort with ample facilities, surrounded by rich nature in a tranquil environment.

name: 雨飾温泉
sales_point: 日本百名山・雨飾山の中腹に位置する温泉地。標高900メートルにある秘湯。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the slopes of Mount Amakazari, one of Japan's 100 famous mountains, at an elevation of 900 meters, known as a hidden hot spring.

name: 荒又温泉
sales_point: 琥珀色の温泉はスベスベして温まる。じょんのび村とこども自然王国という施設に入ることができる。
sales_point_en: Amber-colored hot spring water that warms and smooths the skin. Visitors can access facilities like Jonobi Village and the Children's Nature Kingdom.

name: 五十沢（六日町温泉郷）
sales_point: 六日町駅東方5キロ地点に位置する温泉地。しゃくなげ湖や坂戸山登山口に近く、自然環境が良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 5 kilometers east of Muika-machi Station, close to Shakunage Lake and the trailhead for Mount Sakado, with a good natural environment.

name: 池ノ平（妙高高原温泉郷）
sales_point: 妙高山の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。白樺林の美しい高原の中にあり、閑静な佇まいを見せる。冬はスキー客に人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the eastern foothills of Mount Myoko, nestled in a beautiful white birch forest, offering a serene atmosphere. Popular among skiers in winter.

name: 糸魚川温泉
sales_point: 北陸自動車道糸魚川ICから約3分と近くて便利な温泉地。温水プールも有り。
sales_point_en: A convenient hot spring area located just 3 minutes from the Itoigawa IC on the Hokuriku Expressway, featuring a hot water pool.

name: 芋川（湯之谷温泉郷）
sales_point: 小出駅の東方8キロに位置する温泉地。湯之谷温泉郷の一角。素朴な佇まいと閑静な環境は静養・休養に好適。自然の恵みの山菜・川魚料理が自慢。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 8 kilometers east of Koide Station, part of the Yunotani Onsen area. Its rustic charm and quiet environment make it ideal for relaxation and recuperation, with specialties in wild vegetables and river fish dishes.

name: 岩原温泉
location: 新潟県 南魚沼郡湯沢町
sales_point: 飯士山の麓に位置する温泉地。冬はスキー、夏はトレッキングと心も身も自然の中でリフレッシュできる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Ishi, offering skiing in winter and trekking in summer, allowing for a refreshing experience in nature.

name: 岩室温泉
sales_point: 弥彦山の北東側に位置する温泉地。古くは「霊雁湯」と称され、戦国時代の慶長期にはすでに開湯されていたと伝えられる。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northeast side of Mount Yahiko. Historically known as 'Reigan-yu', it is said to have been opened during the Keicho period of the Sengoku era. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 上の原高原（六日町温泉郷）
sales_point: 六日町西部、八箇峠にほど近い山あいに位置する温泉地。六日町温泉から引湯している。八箇高原スキー場に近接。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains near the western part of Muikamachi, close to Hakkato Pass. It draws water from Muikamachi Onsen and is near Hakka Kogen Ski Resort.

name: 宇津俣温泉
sales_point: 緑豊かな自然に囲まれた牧峠南側山麓に位置する温泉地。宝暦7年に源泉が発見された歴史を誇る。神経痛、皮膚病などに効果がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southern foot of Mount Baki, surrounded by lush nature. It boasts a history dating back to the discovery of its source in the 7th year of the Horeki era. It is effective for neuralgia and skin diseases.

name: 鵜の浜温泉
sales_point: 風光明媚な鵜の浜海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。宿泊者は無料で観光地引き網を体験できるサービスがある。釣り客や海水浴客に好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the scenic Unohama coast. Guests can experience free sightseeing net fishing. It is popular among anglers and beachgoers.

name: 浦佐温泉
sales_point: 浦佐スキー場内に位置する温泉地。日本一おいしい魚沼産コシヒカリと地酒、心を込めたふるさと料理が自慢。奥只見郷、尾瀬への玄関口として親しまれている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within Urasa Ski Resort. It prides itself on serving the delicious Uonuma Koshihikari rice and local sake, along with heartfelt hometown cuisine. It is a gateway to Okutadami and Oze.

name: 上野鉱泉
sales_point: 魚野川の支流、小黒川沿いに位置する温泉地。自炊も可能。保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the tributary of the Uono River, the Oguro River. Self-catering is possible, making it suitable for health and recuperation.

name: 越後長野温泉
sales_point: 守門川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にある秘湯。地元の名産、山菜川魚料理が好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Muramatsu River gorge. It is a hidden hot spring in a quiet mountain environment. Local specialties, such as wild vegetables and river fish dishes, are well-received.

name: 越後二ツ屋俵山温泉
sales_point: 羽根川沿いに位置する温泉地。静かな山あいの自然に囲まれた環境にある。二千年はすの咲く弁天池が近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Hane River, surrounded by quiet mountain nature. The Benten Pond, where the cherry blossoms bloom for two thousand years, is nearby.

name: 大佐渡温泉
sales_point: 春日崎の断崖に位置する温泉地。佐渡金山と相川が一望できる景勝地にある。露天風呂からは海を見おろし、夕日や漁り火が眺められる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the cliffs of Kasugazaki. It offers a scenic view of Sado Gold Mine and Aikawa. From the open-air bath, you can overlook the sea and enjoy sunsets and fishing lights.

name: 大沢山温泉
sales_point: 大沢駅の西方約2キロに位置する温泉地。上越国際スキー場・大沢ゲレンデのすぐ近く。夏は緑の山々に囲まれ閑静な環境。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 2 kilometers west of Oosawa Station. It is very close to Joetsu International Ski Resort and Oosawa Ski Area. In summer, it is surrounded by green mountains in a quiet environment.

name: 大峯温泉
sales_point: 鷹ノ湯・庚申の湯・鐘の湯・湯田の温泉に分かれている。温泉の東側に紅葉の名所、光ヶ原高原があり、秋のシーズンには紅葉狩りを楽しむ人々で賑わう。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is divided into Takanoyu, Koushin no Yu, Kane no Yu, and Yuda Onsen. To the east of the hot spring is the famous autumn foliage spot, Hikogahara Plateau, which attracts many people for leaf-peeping in the fall.

name: 大山温泉
sales_point: 国道253号線のトンネル掘削中に湧出した温泉地。弱アルカリ性の湯は肌の若返りに効果的。豊かな自然のぬくもりと、ふるさとが育む細やかなもてなしの心がある温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area that emerged during the excavation of a tunnel on National Route 253. The mildly alkaline water is effective for skin rejuvenation. It is a hot spring area with the warmth of rich nature and heartfelt hospitality.

name: 大湯（湯之谷温泉郷）
sales_point: 開湯800年の歴史を持つ、湯之谷温泉郷最大の温泉地。川のせせらぎとノスタルジックな湯の町情緒が魅力。奥只見や尾瀬観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: The largest hot spring area in the Yunotani Onsen area, boasting an 800-year history. The sound of the river and the nostalgic atmosphere of the hot spring town are charming. It is well-suited as a base for sightseeing in Okutadami and Oze.

name: 小木温泉
sales_point: 小木港を望む海岸に位置する温泉地。湯治客や町の人々に親しまれている。地魚料理が人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the coast overlooking Ogi Port. It is popular among hot spring visitors and locals. Local fish dishes are a favorite.

name: 小木海岸温泉
sales_point: 遠くは越後の山々、眼下に小木港、漁り火を望む海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。「おぎの湯」の大浴場からのロケーションは最高。各種の浴室の他に貸切風呂、マッサージ室が完備。公共の宿として素泊まり５千円より。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast, with distant views of the Echigo mountains and a view of Ogi Port and fishing lights below. The location from the large public bath 'Ogi no Yu' is excellent. It features various types of baths, private baths, and a massage room. As a public inn, it offers stays starting from 5,000 yen.

name: 折立（湯之谷温泉郷）
sales_point: 佐梨川沿いに位置する温泉地。湯之谷温泉郷の一角で、秀峰越後駒ヶ岳の眺望が良い。湯量豊富で川沿いの露天風呂が人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Sarugawa River. It is part of the Yunotani Onsen area and offers a good view of the majestic Echigo Komagatake mountain. It has abundant hot spring water and popular riverside open-air baths.

name: 貝掛温泉
location: 新潟県 南魚沼郡湯沢町
sales_point: 清津川の支流、カツサ川沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にある一軒宿の秘湯。保養・静養に適し、眼病に特効があるといわれている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Katsusa River, a tributary of the Kiyotsu River. It is a hidden hot spring in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and said to be effective for eye diseases.

name: 貝屋温泉
sales_point: 国道7号線沿いに位置する温泉地。桜樹林の大峰山を背景にした静かな環境にある保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 7. It is in a quiet environment with the backdrop of the cherry tree forest on Mount Oomine, making it suitable for health and recuperation.

name: 柏崎温泉
sales_point: 柏崎駅の北東約1.5キロの海岸に位置する温泉地。行楽客や、海水浴客の利用が多い。四季折々の新鮮な磯料理が堪能できる。家族連れにも最適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 1.5 kilometers northeast of Kashiwazaki Station, along the coast. It is frequently used by leisure and beachgoers. You can enjoy fresh seafood dishes throughout the seasons, making it ideal for families.

name: 柏崎簡保ホーム温泉
sales_point: 米山北側山麓の海岸に面している温泉地。柏崎市内や日本海を一望できる、眺望の良い環境。一般客も宿泊、日帰り入浴可。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing the coast at the foot of Mount Yoneyama. It offers a good view of Kashiwazaki City and the Sea of Japan. Both overnight stays and day-use bathing are available for the general public.

name: 勝見温泉
location: 新潟県 三島郡出雲崎町
sales_point: 日本海に面した民家風の一軒宿の温泉地。夏は海水浴客で賑わう。夕日は絶景。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area resembling a traditional Japanese house facing the Sea of Japan. It is bustling with beachgoers in summer, and the sunset view is spectacular.

name: 桂温泉
sales_point: 長岡市北東部の田園地帯に位置する温泉地。湯量豊富な露天風呂が名物で、開放感溢れる造りとなっている。
sales_point_en: Located in the rural area of northeastern Nagaoka City, this hot spring is famous for its abundant outdoor baths, offering a sense of openness.

name: 金割温泉
sales_point: 蒲原平野の片隅に位置する温泉地。周囲を山、川、田んぼに囲まれており、素朴で閑静な環境にある。鯉料理が名物。
sales_point_en: Situated in a corner of the Kambara Plain, this hot spring is surrounded by mountains, rivers, and rice fields, providing a rustic and tranquil environment. Known for its carp dishes.

name: 鹿瀬温泉
location: 新潟県 東蒲原郡阿賀町
sales_point: 阿賀川沿いの高台に位置する温泉地。奥阿賀の景観がよい。
sales_point_en: Located on a high ground along the Agagawa River, this hot spring offers beautiful views of the Oku-Aga landscape.

name: 鹿伏温泉
sales_point: 相川の海岸沿いに位置し、日本海を望む温泉地。日本海に沈む夕日と水平線に浮かぶ漁り火は特に美しい。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located along the coast of Aikawa, overlooking the Sea of Japan. The sunset over the Sea of Japan and the fishing lights on the horizon are particularly beautiful.

name: 神湯温泉
sales_point: 権現堂登山口近くに位置する温泉地。スキー場も近く、オートキャンプ場や、彫刻清流公園なども整備され、通年楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located near the Gongen-do mountain trailhead, this hot spring is close to ski resorts and features auto camping sites and a sculpture park, making it enjoyable year-round.

name: 観音寺温泉
location: 新潟県 西蒲原郡弥彦村
sales_point: 弥彦山の南東側に位置する温泉地。11世紀の発見と伝えられ、歴史が永い。閑静な環境にあり、引湯先の弥彦温泉と共に、国民保養温泉地に指定されている。保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located on the southeast side of Mount Yahiko and is said to have been discovered in the 11th century, boasting a long history. It is in a quiet environment and designated as a national health resort along with Yahiko Onsen, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: キャンパス川口温泉
location: 新潟県 北魚沼郡川口町
sales_point: 霊峰越後三山を仰ぎ、信濃川と魚野川の合流点近くに位置する温泉地。この合流点に沈む夕陽の眺めは特に素晴らしい。
sales_point_en: Situated near the confluence of the Shinano River and the Uono River, this hot spring offers a stunning view of the sunset at this confluence, with the sacred peaks of the Echigo Sanzan in the background.

name: 清津峡温泉
sales_point: 日本三大峡谷のひとつに数えられる清津峡の入口に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にある秘湯。トンネルの遊歩道から渓谷の柱状節理を間近に見られるのが特色。四季の自然に恵まれている。
sales_point_en: Located at the entrance of Kiyotsu Gorge, one of Japan's three major gorges, this hot spring is a hidden gem in a quiet environment. Visitors can see the columnar jointing of the gorge up close from the walking path in the tunnel, surrounded by seasonal nature.

name: 雲母温泉
location: 新潟県 岩船郡関川村
sales_point: 飯豊連峰北側の丘陵に位置する温泉地。「子宝の湯」として知られている。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located on the hillsides of the northern Iide mountain range and is known as the 'Childbirth Hot Spring.'

name: 麒麟山温泉
location: 新潟県 東蒲原郡阿賀町
sales_point: 阿賀野川と常浪川の合流点にそびえる麒麟山の山麓に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: Situated at the foot of Mount Kirinzan, overlooking the confluence of the Aganogawa and Jōrōgawa rivers, this hot spring is in a quiet environment.

name: 鯨波松島温泉
sales_point: 県を代表する鯨波海水浴場から徒歩約5分、鯨波駅前に位置する温泉地。海、山に囲まれ自然環境に恵まれている。日本海を一望できる展望風呂からの夕日は絶景。
sales_point_en: Located about a 5-minute walk from the representative Kujiranami beach, this hot spring is surrounded by mountains and nature. The sunset view from the open-air bath overlooking the Sea of Japan is breathtaking.

name: グリーンピア津南温泉
location: 新潟県 中魚沼郡津南町
sales_point: 苗場山の山麓に位置する温泉地。大型のリゾート施設で、スキー場が併設されており、スポーツ施設が充実している。
sales_point_en: Located at the foot of Mount Naeba, this hot spring is part of a large resort facility that includes a ski resort and well-equipped sports facilities.

name: 結東温泉
location: 新潟県 中魚沼郡津南町
sales_point: 中津川河畔に位置する温泉地。秘境秋山郷、中津川渓谷を見おろす展望は絶景。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located by the Nakatsukawa River, offering a stunning view of the secret Akiyamago region and the Nakatsukawa gorge.

name: 河原沢鉱泉（六日町温泉郷）
sales_point: 六日町の北部、五日町スキー場に近接した温泉地。沢沿いの閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: Located in the northern part of Muikamachi, close to the Itsukamachi ski resort, this hot spring is in a quiet environment along a stream.

name: 小坂温泉
location: 新潟県 南魚沼郡湯沢町
sales_point: リゾートホテル内にある温泉。露天風大浴場で、リラックス＆リフレッシュ。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located within a resort hotel, featuring an open-air bath for relaxation and refreshment.

name: 越乃湯温泉
sales_point: 与板町北方の丘陵地に位置する温泉地。一軒宿で湯治ムードが漂う。閑静な環境にあり保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated in the hilly area north of Yaita Town, this hot spring is a single inn that exudes a healing atmosphere, ideal for recuperation and therapy in a quiet environment.

name: 駒の湯（湯之谷温泉郷）
sales_point: 佐梨川上流の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。湯之谷温泉郷のひとつに数えられる。ランプの灯る一軒宿の秘湯。駒ヶ岳登山基地にも好適。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located along the upper reaches of the Sarugawa River, this hot spring is one of the Yunotani Onsen area. It is a hidden gem with a lamp-lit inn, suitable as a base for climbing Mount Komagatake and designated as a national health resort.

name: 逆巻温泉
location: 新潟県 中魚沼郡津南町
sales_point: 苗場山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。中津川渓谷に臨む山あいにある。平家の落人が住みついたと言われる秘境。閑静で風光明媚な環境。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located on the northern foothills of Mount Naeba, in the mountains overlooking the Nakatsukawa gorge. It is said to be a hidden area where the Heike clan's refugees settled, offering a quiet and picturesque environment.

name: 咲花温泉
sales_point: 阿賀野川河畔近くに位置する温泉地。県内屈指の湯量を誇る。釣りや山菜摘みも楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located near the banks of the Aganogawa River, this hot spring boasts one of the highest water volumes in the prefecture, and visitors can enjoy fishing and wild vegetable picking.

name: 笹倉温泉
sales_point: 焼山山麓の早川河畔に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境に恵まれた山のいで湯。保養・静養に最適。
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area located by the Hayakawa River at the foot of Mount Yakeyama, perfect for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 佐渡加茂湖温泉
sales_point: 加茂湖の東側湖畔に位置している。肌がスベスベになる美人の湯。
sales_point_en: Located on the eastern lakeside of Kamoko Lake, this hot spring is known for its beautifying waters that leave your skin smooth.

name: 佐和田温泉
sales_point: 佐渡島の中央にある佐和田海岸に位置する温泉地。赤玉湯とも言われる。波静かな海岸では海水浴を楽しむことが出来る。
sales_point_en: Situated on the Sawada coast in the center of Sado Island, this hot spring is also known as Akadama-yu. Enjoy swimming at the calm beach.

name: 椎崎温泉
sales_point: 佐渡両津港南西の加茂湖東側湖畔に位置する温泉地。湖はもとより、大佐渡の山々の眺望が素晴らしく、閑静な環境に恵まれている。
sales_point_en: Located on the eastern lakeside of Kamoko Lake, southwest of Ryotsu Port, this hot spring offers stunning views of the mountains and a peaceful environment.

name: 塩沢温泉
sales_point: 塩沢町の中心部に位置する温泉地。広々とした露天風呂が完備されており、日帰り入浴も可。
sales_point_en: Located in the center of Shiozawa Town, this hot spring features spacious outdoor baths and is open for day-use.

name: 塩之又温泉
sales_point: 魚沼スカイライン沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。家庭的な雰囲気を持っている。上越国際スキー場が近い。
sales_point_en: Nestled in the mountains along the Uonuma Skyline, this hot spring has a homely atmosphere and is close to the Joetsu International Ski Resort.

name: 鹿渡温泉
location: 新潟県 中魚沼郡津南町
sales_point: 越後鹿渡駅前にある閑静な環境の温泉地。湯治目的の近郷の人々で賑わいを見せる。熊鍋、薬草料理が名物。
sales_point_en: A quiet hot spring area located in front of Echigo Kawadate Station, popular among locals for therapeutic purposes. Known for its bear hot pot and herbal cuisine.

name: 島道温泉
sales_point: 能生駅の東南約6キロ、能生川の支流、島道川の谷あいに位置する温泉地。山菜料理が好評。
sales_point_en: Located about 6 kilometers southeast of Naoetsu Station, this hot spring is nestled in the valley of the Shimamichi River and is famous for its wild vegetable dishes.

name: 白根温泉
sales_point: 信濃川と中ノ口川の間に挟まれた田園地帯に位置する温泉地。新潟市郊外の行楽や保養に適した温泉となっている。自然環境に恵まれ、夏にはホタルが飛び交う。
sales_point_en: Situated in a rural area between the Shinano River and Nakano River, this hot spring is ideal for leisure and recuperation near Niigata City, surrounded by nature with fireflies in summer.

name: 新赤倉（妙高高原温泉郷）
sales_point: 妙高山の山麓に位置する温泉地。高原の中にゴルフ、スキー、テニス場などがあり、一年中リゾート地として賑わいを見せる。
sales_point_en: Located at the foot of Mount Myoko, this hot spring area features golf, skiing, and tennis facilities, bustling year-round as a resort.

name: 新樽ケ橋温泉
sales_point: 櫛形山脈の北側山麓、胎内川沿いに位置する温泉地。上流にかけて秋の紅葉が美しい。
sales_point_en: Located along the Taikai River at the northern foot of the Kushigata Mountain Range, this hot spring offers beautiful autumn foliage upstream.

name: 新三川温泉
location: 新潟県 東蒲原郡阿賀町
sales_point: 阿賀野川の支流、新谷川沿いに位置する温泉地。温泉スライダー、回流式温泉プール等の施設も整備されている。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Shintani River, a tributary of the Agano River, this hot spring features facilities like a hot spring slider and a recirculating hot spring pool.

name: 地蔵温泉
sales_point: 山峡のひなびた一軒宿の温泉地。
sales_point_en: A rustic hot spring area with a single inn nestled in a mountain gorge.

name: 成願寺温泉
sales_point: 八方台への登山口、成願池に隣接している温泉地。長岡の奥座敷として、豊かな自然環境の中、四季折々の風情が楽しめる。鯉料理が名物。
sales_point_en: Adjacent to the trailhead for Hakkodai and Seigan Pond, this hot spring is known as the hidden retreat of Nagaoka, surrounded by rich natural beauty and seasonal charm. Famous for its carp dishes.

name: 上下浜温泉
sales_point: 日本海を望む川西浜海水浴場近くに位置する温泉地。夏は海水浴客で賑わう。日本海に沈む夕陽は格別。
sales_point_en: Located near the Kawanisi Hama beach overlooking the Sea of Japan, this hot spring is bustling with beachgoers in summer. The sunsets over the Japan Sea are exceptional.

name: 住吉温泉
sales_point: 両津港の南東、住吉海水浴場の近くに位置する温泉地。夏は海水浴客で賑わう。昔から「トキの傷湯」と言われたところ。
sales_point_en: Located southeast of Ryotsu Port, near Sumiyoshi Beach, this hot spring is popular with beachgoers in summer and has been known as 'Toki's Healing Hot Spring' since ancient times.

name: 守門温泉
sales_point: 守門岳山麓の西川河畔に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にある。付近にファミリープールやキャンプ場が整備され、家族連れに好評。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Nishikawa River at the foot of Mount Sumon, this hot spring is in a quiet environment, with family pools and campgrounds nearby, popular among families.

name: 寿和温泉
sales_point: 破間川の河畔に位置する温泉地。豊富な湯量を誇る。
sales_point_en: Located along the banks of the Hamagawa River, this hot spring boasts abundant hot water.

name: 関温泉
sales_point: 神奈山の南東側山麓に位置する温泉地。弘法大師の発見と伝えられ、歴史が永い。標高950メートルの高原にあり、大田切川渓谷沿いに遊歩道が整備され、景観が良好。冬はスキーが楽しめる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located on the southeastern foothills of Mount Kanagata, this hot spring is said to have been discovered by Kobo Daishi and has a long history. Situated at an elevation of 950 meters, it features a scenic walking path along the Otagiri River gorge and is great for skiing in winter. A national health resort.

name: 瀬戸口温泉
sales_point: 清津川河畔にある閑静な環境の温泉地。ゆっくりと静養したい人に最適。紅葉の名所、瀬戸口渓谷に是非訪れてみたい。
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area located by the Kiyotsu River, perfect for those looking to relax. A must-visit during the autumn foliage season at the scenic Setoguchi Gorge.

name: 瀬波温泉
sales_point: 日本海の海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。松林が連なる風光明媚な環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast of the Sea of Japan, surrounded by picturesque pine forests.

name: 胎内温泉
sales_point: 紅葉の名所、胎内渓谷の下流に位置する温泉地。総合観光施設の中にあり、飯豊登山、スキー基地として好適。
sales_point_en: Located downstream of the famous autumn foliage spot, Tainai Gorge. It is part of a comprehensive tourist facility, ideal for mountain climbing and skiing.

name: 高瀬温泉
location: 新潟県 岩船郡関川村
sales_point: 荒川のほとりに位置する温泉地。田園風景が広がるのどかな環境に位置し、休養に好適。設備の整った宿が多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area situated by the Arakawa River, in a peaceful rural setting, perfect for relaxation. Many well-equipped accommodations are available.

name: 高坪温泉
sales_point: 石油の里で知られる新津市街地の南東に位置する温泉地。のどかな雰囲気の中にあり、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located southeast of Niitsu city, known for its oil production. It offers a tranquil atmosphere, ideal for recuperation and therapy.

name: 鷹ノ巣温泉
location: 新潟県 岩船郡関川村
sales_point: 荒川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。景観が美しく閑静な環境にある。鮎釣りやハイキングを楽しめる。保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area along the Arakawa Gorge, known for its beautiful scenery and quiet environment. Great for enjoying ayu fishing and hiking.

name: 辰ノ口温泉
location: 新潟県 中魚沼郡津南町
sales_point: 信濃川の北岸に位置する温泉地。越後鹿渡駅のすぐ近くにある。近郷の人々に湯治場として親しまれている。
sales_point_en: Located on the north bank of the Shinano River, very close to Echigo Kawatari Station. It is a popular healing spot for locals.

name: 田中温泉
location: 新潟県 中魚沼郡津南町
sales_point: 越後田中駅の南、信濃川沿いに位置する温泉地。マントパーク津南スキー場が近い。夏場は釣り客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: Situated south of Echigo Tanaka Station along the Shinano River, close to the Mant Park Tsunan Ski Resort. Bustling with fishing enthusiasts in the summer.

name: 田ノ浦温泉
sales_point: 越後七浦シーサイドライン沿いに位置する温泉地。日本海の眺望が良く、風光明媚な環境にある。田ノ浦海水浴場が近い。
sales_point_en: Located along the Echigo Nanaura Seaside Line, offering great views of the Sea of Japan in a scenic environment. Close to Tanoura Beach.

name: 中子沢温泉
sales_point: 唐松山、上権現堂山の山麓に位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Karasumatsu and Mount Kamigongen.

name: 長者温泉
sales_point: 鉾ヶ岳南西側山麓に位置する温泉地。美しい自然に囲まれて閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southwestern foot of Mount Hoko, surrounded by beautiful nature in a quiet environment.

name: 津川温泉
location: 新潟県 東蒲原郡阿賀町
sales_point: 県立自然公園阿賀野ラインの中心にある清川高原の中腹に位置する温泉地。眼下に阿賀野川を一望でき、眺望が良い。泉質は高く、素肌美人を生み出すと言われている。
sales_point_en: Located in the center of the AGA Natural Park, on the slopes of Kiyokawa Plateau, offering a great view of the Agano River below. Known for its high-quality water that is said to enhance skin beauty.

name: 月岡温泉
sales_point: のどかな環境にありながら、新潟の奥座敷として華やかな雰囲気を持つ温泉地。世界ガラス展示館などを併設した「月岡カリオンパーク」がある。肌がすべすべすることから「美人の湯」として知られる。
sales_point_en: While in a tranquil environment, it has a vibrant atmosphere as Niigata's hidden gem. Features the Tsukioka Karyon Park, which includes the World Glass Exhibition Hall. Known as the 'Beauty Hot Spring' for its skin-smoothing properties.

name: 月湯女温泉
sales_point: 山中トンネル南側の国道252号線沿いに位置する温泉地。歴史があり、薬効高い名湯。
sales_point_en: A historic hot spring area located along National Route 252, south of the Yamanaka Tunnel, known for its high medicinal properties.

name: 津南駅前温泉
location: 新潟県 中魚沼郡津南町
sales_point: ＪＲ津南駅構内に位置する温泉地。駅舎を兼ねた建物の中に温泉施設がある。マントパーク津南スキー場が近い。
sales_point_en: Located within the JR Tsunan Station building, this hot spring facility is conveniently situated. Close to the Mant Park Tsunan Ski Resort.

name: 角神温泉
location: 新潟県 東蒲原郡阿賀町
sales_point: 阿賀野川沿いに位置する温泉地。白樺などの林に囲まれて自然環境が良い。一年を通して様々なスポーツを楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Agano River, surrounded by birch and other forests, providing a great natural environment. Enjoy various sports year-round.

name: 燕温泉
sales_point: 妙高山の南東側山麓、標高1100メートルに位置する温泉地。弘法大師の発見とされ、歴史が永い。岩ツバメが群れ飛ぶ環境にあり、大田切川渓谷沿いの景観も良い。冬はスキーも楽しめる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located at an elevation of 1100 meters on the southeastern foot of Mount Myoko. Believed to have been discovered by Kobo Daishi, it has a long history. Surrounded by swallows and offers beautiful views along the Otakigawa Gorge. Skiing is also enjoyable in winter. A national health resort.

name: 寺泊温泉
sales_point: 寺泊海岸から奥に入ったところにある温泉地。古くから湯治場として親しまれる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located a bit inland from Teradomari Beach, cherished as a healing spot since ancient times.

name: 寺泊海岸温泉
sales_point: 寺泊海岸に位置する温泉地。魚の市場通り（魚のアメ横）、中央海水浴場にほど近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on Teradomari Beach, very close to the fish market street and the central beach.

name: 天王山温泉
sales_point: 宿の主人が自分で山の麓から引いてきた一軒宿の温泉地。
sales_point_en: A unique hot spring area run by an innkeeper who personally brings water from the foot of the mountain.

name: 出湯温泉
sales_point: 五頭・菱ヶ岳の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。1000年以上の永い歴史を持つ。静かな環境で保養・療養に好適。湯治宿もある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of the Gozu and Hishigatake mountains. It has a long history of over 1000 years and is suitable for recuperation and therapy in a quiet environment. There are also healing inns available.

name: 栃尾又（湯之谷温泉郷）
sales_point: 佐梨川支流の栃尾又沢沿いに位置する温泉地。湯之谷温泉郷最古のいで湯で、子宝の湯として知られている秘湯。低温長時間浴の習慣がある。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Tochio Mata River, a tributary of the Sazugawa River. It is the oldest hot spring in the Yunotani Onsen district, known as a secret hot spring for fertility. It has a tradition of low-temperature long baths and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 栃窪温泉
sales_point: 晴れた日には魚沼連峰が隅々まで見渡せる温泉。シャトー塩沢スキー場近接している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring where you can see the Uonuma mountain range in its entirety on clear days. It is close to the Chateau Shiozawa ski resort.

name: 栃窪温泉
sales_point: 米山西南側山麓の小高い山の中腹に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。また、米山の登山基地にも最適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the hillside of a small mountain on the southwestern foothills of Komeyama. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and relaxation, and is also ideal as a base for climbing Komeyama.

name: 苗場温泉
location: 新潟県 南魚沼郡湯沢町
sales_point: 苗場山の麓に位置する温泉地。大自然に囲まれて、のんびりゆったりくつろげる。秋の紅葉は特別。冬季はスキー場が近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Naeba. Surrounded by nature, it offers a relaxing and leisurely experience. The autumn foliage is particularly special, and it is close to ski resorts in winter.

name: 中里温泉
location: 新潟県 南魚沼郡湯沢町
sales_point: 中里地区に位置する温泉地。四季にふれてくつろげる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Nakazato district, where you can relax and enjoy the changing seasons.

name: 長岡温泉
sales_point: 長岡市街、南東部の田園風景の中に位置する温泉地。湯量が豊富で行楽・保養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southeastern rural landscape of Nagaoka City. It has abundant hot water, making it suitable for leisure and recuperation.

name: 長岡かまぶろ温泉
sales_point: 越後滝谷駅の北方約2キロの田園地帯に位置する温泉地。京都で古くに誕生したという、全国でも有数のかまぶろ（蒸し風呂の一種）を備えている。心臓や筋肉に負担をかけない熱気療法として人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 2 kilometers north of Echigo Takidani Station in a rural area. It features one of the few kamaburo (a type of steam bath) that originated in Kyoto. It is popular as a heat therapy that does not strain the heart or muscles.

name: 荷頃鉱泉
sales_point: 栃尾市街の西南4キロに位置し、山と田園に囲まれた一軒宿の温泉地。創業は明治に遡る。閑静な環境で静養・保養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 4 kilometers southwest of Tochio City, surrounded by mountains and fields. It dates back to the Meiji era and is suitable for recuperation in a quiet environment.

name: 西谷温泉
sales_point: 国道404号線沿いに位置する温泉地。家庭的な雰囲気を味わえ、人情味に溢れている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 404. It offers a homely atmosphere filled with warmth and friendliness.

name: ニュ－浅草岳温泉
sales_point: 浅草岳の山麓に位置する温泉地。ユニークな天然の岩盤をくり抜いた展望洞窟風呂がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Asakusa. It features a unique natural rock cave bath with a scenic view.

name: 野積温泉
sales_point: 野積海水場の目の前に位置する温泉地。弥彦の神様ゆかりの温泉地でもある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located right in front of Nozomi Seaside. It is also associated with the deity of Yahiko.

name: 白馬温泉
sales_point: 姫川渓谷を見下ろす高台に位置する温泉地。白馬大仏が目印。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a high ground overlooking the Himekawa Valley. The Hakuba Great Buddha is a landmark.

name: 畑野温泉
sales_point: 女神山の北側山麓に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。岩、檜、展望と様々な風呂が楽しめ、その他打たせ湯、泡湯、ミストサウナなどもあり、リラックスできる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northern foothills of Megami Mountain. It offers various baths including rock, cypress, and scenic baths, as well as other facilities like jet baths, bubble baths, and mist saunas for relaxation.

name: ハッカ石温泉
sales_point: 石打丸山スキー場のゲレンデに隣接する温泉地。大露天風呂からは四季折々の風情が感じられる。スキーシーズン中は24時間営業している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area adjacent to the slopes of the Ishiuchi Maruyama Ski Resort. The large open-air bath allows you to enjoy the seasonal scenery. It is open 24 hours during the ski season.

name: 平根崎温泉
sales_point: 平根崎の海中に湧く温泉。潜水中のダイバーが偶然に発見したという。展望大浴場より、日本海が一望できる。佐渡一番の高温泉。
sales_point_en: A hot spring that springs from the sea at Hiranesaki. It was discovered by a diver while underwater. The large public bath offers a panoramic view of the Sea of Japan and is known as the hottest spring in Sado.

name: 広田鉱泉温泉
sales_point: 古くから小千谷街道を行く旅人の湯治場として親しまれている温泉地。閑静なたたずまいの中で四季折々の自然に風情を満喫できる。県内屈指の薬湯。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area that has long been cherished as a healing place for travelers on the Ojiya Highway. You can enjoy the seasonal beauty of nature in a tranquil setting. It is one of the top medicinal hot springs in the prefecture.

name: 二居温泉
location: 新潟県 南魚沼郡湯沢町
sales_point: 三国街道二居宿に位置する温泉地。街道沿いのロマンを堪能できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the Futatsu lodging on the Mikuni Highway. You can enjoy the romance of the highway.

name: 舞子温泉
sales_point: 舞子後楽園スキー場に隣接する温泉地。夏はゴンドラに乗って、山頂からの雄大な景色が楽しめる。日帰り入浴も可能。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area adjacent to the Maiko Kourakuen Ski Resort. In summer, you can take a gondola to enjoy the magnificent views from the mountaintop. Day-use bathing is also available.

name: 馬下温泉
sales_point: 五泉市の東部、馬下駅近くに位置する温泉地。豊富な湯量を誇る。地元住民から市外の人々にまで、親しまれる公共の温泉施設もある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the eastern part of Gosen City, near Umashita Station. It boasts abundant hot water and is a public hot spring facility loved by local residents and visitors from outside the city.

name: 柵口温泉
sales_point: 権現岳の北東側山麓に位置する温泉地。権現岳から鉾ヶ岳縦走の登山口にあたる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northeastern foothills of Mount Gongendake, serving as the trailhead for the hike from Gongendake to Hokogatake.

name: 松ケ峰温泉
sales_point: 妙高山東側山麓に位置する温泉地。スキー場とゴルフ場が周囲に多く、通年楽しむことができる。また、日本海にも近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the eastern foothills of Mount Myoko, surrounded by many ski resorts and golf courses, making it enjoyable year-round. It is also close to the Sea of Japan.

name: 松代温泉
sales_point: 北越急行松代駅の西方、標高400メートルの高台に位置する温泉地。濁川の最上流が近くを流れる自然に恵まれた環境にある。松代城からの眺望は素晴らしい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 400 meters above sea level, west of Matsushiro Station on the Hokuriku Railway. It is blessed with nature, as the upper reaches of the Nugawa River flow nearby, and offers a wonderful view from Matsushiro Castle.

name: 松之山温泉
sales_point: 天水山の山麓に位置する温泉地。多くの伝説を秘め、自然に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。効能も顕著で保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foothills of Mount Amamizu, surrounded by nature and steeped in many legends. It is known for its notable health benefits, making it suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: 丸山温泉
sales_point: 石打丸山スキー場の麓に位置する温泉地。冬季スキー客の旅館として営業している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the base of the Ishiuchi Maruyama Ski Resort, operating as an inn for winter ski guests.

name: 御神楽温泉
location: 新潟県 東蒲原郡阿賀町
sales_point: 御神楽岳の南側山麓、広谷川沿いに位置する温泉地。雄大な御神楽岳が遠望できることから命名された。湯は美肌作用があるといわれる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Hirotani River at the southern foothills of Mount Mikagura. Named for the majestic view of Mount Mikagura, the waters are said to have beautifying effects.

name: 三川温泉
location: 新潟県 東蒲原郡阿賀町
sales_point: 阿賀野川の支流、新谷川の下流に位置する温泉地。古くからの温泉で、新潟の奥座敷として親しまれている。鯉料理が有名。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located downstream of the Shintani River, a tributary of the Agano River. It has been a beloved hot spring for a long time, known as the hidden retreat of Niigata, famous for its carp dishes.

name: 三島谷温泉
sales_point: 長岡市西部の三島谷川沿いに位置する温泉地。全国的にも珍しい紅茶色の薬泉名湯で知られる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Mishimadani River in the western part of Nagaoka City, known for its rare reddish-brown medicinal waters.

name: 見附温泉
sales_point: 長岡市と三条市の中間の田園地帯に位置する温泉地。近くに上杉謙信ゆかりの椿沢寺がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the rural area between Nagaoka City and Sanjo City, near the Tsubakizawa Temple, which is associated with Uesugi Kenshin.

name: 三俣温泉
location: 新潟県 南魚沼郡湯沢町
sales_point: 三国街道三俣宿に位置する温泉地。街中を離れ、ゆっくりと湯につかると気分も格別。身も心もほぐれる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Mimata-juku along the Mikuni Highway. Stepping away from the town and soaking in the hot springs provides a unique and relaxing experience.

name: 宮中島温泉
sales_point: 雄大な信濃川の河畔に位置する温泉地。ヘルシーレジャースポットとして日帰りの温泉施設がある。スパ・ゾーンとバーデ・ゾーンがあり、のんびりリフレッシュできる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the banks of the majestic Shinano River, featuring day-use facilities as a healthy leisure spot. It has a spa zone and a bathing zone for a relaxing refresh.

name: 宮野原温泉
location: 新潟県 中魚沼郡津南町
sales_point: 長野県境に近い信濃川の河畔に位置する温泉地。信濃川の眺望が素晴らしい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the banks of the Shinano River, close to the Nagano Prefecture border, offering a wonderful view of the river.

name: 宮本温泉
sales_point: 三島谷温泉の東方2キロの丘陵地に位置する温泉地。豆刺し、牛カン、山フグと独特な料理が味わえる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the hilly region 2 kilometers east of Mishimadani Onsen, where you can enjoy unique dishes such as bean-stuffed dumplings, beef kan, and mountain pufferfish.

name: 妙高パインバレ－温泉
sales_point: パインバレーリゾートゾーンの中に位置する温泉地。四季折々に輝く妙高山の眺望が良い。各種スポーツを通年楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within the Pine Valley Resort Zone, offering great views of Mount Myoko, which shines in every season. Various sports can be enjoyed year-round.

name: 妙高（妙高高原温泉郷）
sales_point: 妙高高原駅の南西、関川沿いに位置する温泉地。東、西方にスキー場が点在しており、家族連れにも好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located southwest of Myoko Kogen Station along the Sekigawa River, with ski resorts scattered to the east and west, popular with families.

name: 六日町（六日町温泉郷）
sales_point: 米どころで知られる六日町の中心街に近接した温泉地。スキー場が多く、冬場は賑わいを見せる。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area close to the center of Muikamachi, known for its rice production. It is bustling with activity during winter due to the many ski resorts and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 葎沢（湯之谷温泉郷）
sales_point: 湯之谷温泉郷の玄関口にあたる温泉地。佐梨川沿いの田園地帯に位置し、閑静な環境にある。ひなびた風情が人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area that serves as the gateway to the Yunotani Onsen area, located in a rural area along the Sazugawa River, known for its tranquil environment and rustic charm.

name: 村杉温泉
sales_point: 五頭山・菱ヶ岳の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。ラジウムの含有量が多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the western foothills of Mount Gozu and Hishigatake, in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and relaxation, with a high radium content.

name: 焼山温泉
sales_point: 早川の上流に位置する温泉地。夏は緑に囲まれた高台でテニス、ゲートボール、冬はスキー場と楽しみがいっぱい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located upstream of the Hayakawa River, surrounded by greenery in summer, offering tennis and gateball, and a ski resort in winter for plenty of enjoyment.

name: 八幡温泉
sales_point: 真野湾の入り江に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、静養や観光、海水浴の基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a cove of Mano Bay, in a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation, sightseeing, and as a base for beach activities.

name: 弥彦温泉
location: 新潟県 西蒲原郡弥彦村
sales_point: 弥彦山の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。弥彦神社の参道沿いの門前町にある。弥彦神社から弥彦山へはロープウェイが架けられ、山頂付近には展望台や弥彦山自然館などが整備されている。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the eastern foot of Mount Yahiko, along the approach to Yahiko Shrine. A ropeway connects Yahiko Shrine to Mount Yahiko, where there are observation decks and the Yahiko Mountain Nature Museum. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: ゆきだるま温泉
sales_point: 男女共100名が入れる県下最大の温泉。肌が雪のように白くなると言われている。スキー場が隣接している。
sales_point_en: The largest hot spring in the prefecture, accommodating 100 people of both genders. It is said to make the skin as white as snow. A ski resort is adjacent.

name: 湯沢温泉
location: 新潟県 岩船郡関川村
sales_point: 荒川支流の注ぐ支流の湯蔵川沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yurakugawa River, a tributary of the Arakawa River. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: 湯沢温泉
location: 新潟県 南魚沼郡湯沢町
sales_point: 小説「雪国」の島村と駒子のロマンスの舞台となった温泉地。800年の歴史を誇る。四季折々の風情を楽しむことができる。冬季はスキーの基地となる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area that served as the setting for the romance between Shimamura and Komako in the novel 'Snow Country.' It boasts an 800-year history and offers seasonal beauty. In winter, it becomes a base for skiing.

name: 湯之腰温泉
sales_point: 弥彦連山の北端、角田山北東側山麓に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。家庭的な暖かいもてなしと温まる温泉が好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northern end of the Yahiko mountain range, on the northeastern foothills of Mount Kakuda. It is well-regarded for its warm hospitality and soothing hot springs.

name: 蓬平温泉
sales_point: 太田川上流、三方を山々に囲まれる盆地に位置する温泉地。素朴な雰囲気を持ち、金運・商売繁盛の神様、高龍神社と共に栄えてきた。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a basin surrounded by mountains, upstream of the Ota River. It has a rustic atmosphere and has prospered alongside the deity of wealth and business, Koryu Shrine.

name: 両津秋津温泉
sales_point: 加茂湖の西、佐渡空港近くの秋津に位置する温泉地。空港からのアクセスが便利。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Akitsu, near Sado Airport, west of Kamo Lake. It offers convenient access from the airport.

name: 蓮華温泉
sales_point: 白馬岳の東北側山麓に位置する温泉地。標高1475メートルの高所にある秘湯。３つの露天風呂は風情満点。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northeastern foothills of Mount Hakuba, at an elevation of 1,475 meters. It is a hidden hot spring with three outdoor baths full of charm.

name: 赤碕温泉
sales_point: 観音崎の少し手前、七尾湾に面した山肌に位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the mountainside facing Nanao Bay, just before Kannonzaki.

name: 赤穂谷温泉
sales_point: 白山山麓へ向かう街道沿いに位置する温泉地。静かで素朴な山里の雰囲気を堪能できる。開湯100年の歴史がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the highway leading to the foothills of Mount Hakusan. It offers a quiet and rustic mountain village atmosphere and has a history of 100 years since its opening.

name: 粟津（加賀温泉郷）
sales_point: 718年、白山開山の祖、泰澄大師の発見と伝えられる温泉地。北陸最古の歴史を有する温泉地で、閑静な環境にある。温泉街には「黄門杉」などの見所もある。加賀温泉郷のひとつに数えられている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area believed to have been discovered by Taichu Daishi, the founder of Mount Hakusan, in 718. It has the oldest history in Hokuriku and is located in a quiet environment. The hot spring town features attractions such as 'Komon Sugi.' It is counted among the Kaga Onsen-kyo.

name: 内灘砂丘放水路温泉
location: 石川県 河北郡内灘町
sales_point: 日本海と河北潟に挟まれた高台に位置する温泉地。展望浴場からの眺めは素晴らしい。河北潟、内灘海岸探勝基地に好適。
name_en: Uchinada Sand Dune Drainage Canal Onsen
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a high ground between the Sea of Japan and Kahokugata. The view from the open-air bath is wonderful, making it suitable as a base for exploring Kahokugata and Uchinada Beach.

name: 女原温泉
sales_point: 尾口村役場の近く、村の中心部に位置する温泉地。肌がつるつるになる良質の湯を楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the village office of Oguchi, in the center of the village. It offers high-quality waters that make the skin smooth.

name: 加賀橋立温泉
sales_point: 近年発見された温泉で、近くの漁港に水揚げされる新鮮な海の幸が味わえる。
sales_point_en: A recently discovered hot spring where you can enjoy fresh seafood caught at the nearby fishing port.

name: 加賀三谷温泉
sales_point: ひっそりとした山間に位置する温泉地。近くに美しい渓流と小さな滝があり、静かな保養地となっている。聖徳太子ゆかりの里で、太子温泉や大聖寺温泉とも言われる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area quietly located in the mountains. Nearby, there are beautiful streams and small waterfalls, making it a peaceful retreat. It is associated with Prince Shotoku and is also referred to as Taishi Onsen or Daishoji Onsen.

name: 加賀八幡温泉
sales_point: 加賀平野を一望できる丘陵地に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、静養・保養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a hill overlooking the Kaga Plain. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 片山津（加賀温泉郷）
sales_point: 柴山潟の南岸沿いに位置する温泉地。明るく開放的な環境からレジャー向きの温泉として人気が高い。加賀温泉郷のひとつ。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the southern shore of Shibayama Lake. It is popular as a leisure-oriented hot spring due to its bright and open environment. It is one of the Kaga Onsen-kyo.

name: 金沢松島温泉
sales_point: 西金沢駅の北西約3キロの金沢市市街地に位置する温泉地。市内観光拠点として便利。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 3 kilometers northwest of Nishi Kanazawa Station, in the city center of Kanazawa. It is convenient as a base for city sightseeing.

name: 河内千丈温泉
sales_point: 直海谷川の上流、美しい渓谷の中に位置する温泉地。山あいにあり、山菜採り、渓流釣りやスキーが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located upstream of the Chokai Valley River, in a beautiful gorge. It is in the mountains, where you can enjoy mountain vegetable picking, stream fishing, and skiing.

name: 観音温泉
