location: 長野県 上高井郡高山村
sales_point: 松川渓谷沿いにある自炊の一軒宿の温泉地。自然環境が良い。
sales_point_en: A self-catering hot spring located along the Matsukawa Valley, known for its excellent natural environment.

name: 松沢鉱泉温泉
location: 長野県 北安曇郡池田町
sales_point: 大町市の東隣の池田町に位置する温泉地。明治初期の開業の一軒宿で歴史は古く、信州38秘湯の１つと言われている。湯上がり後は肌がすべすべになる。
sales_point_en: Located in Ikeda Town, adjacent to Omachi City, this historic hot spring has been in operation since the early Meiji period and is considered one of the 38 secret hot springs of Shinshu. The skin feels smooth after bathing.

name: 松代温泉
sales_point: 尼厳山西側山麓の田園の中に位置する温泉地。歴史は古く、かつて武田信玄の隠し湯として使われていた。川中島の古戦場も近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the rural foothills of Mount Nigen, with a long history, once used as a hidden hot spring by Takeda Shingen. It is also close to the historic battlefield of Kawanakajima.

name: まほら伊那羽広温泉
sales_point: 中央道伊那ICから程近く、南アルプスの眺望が良い温泉地。効能が高く、特に美肌に効果抜群。いちご狩り、農業体験ができ、産直市場もある。
sales_point_en: Located near the Ina IC on the Chuo Expressway, this hot spring offers great views of the Southern Alps and is known for its high efficacy, especially for beautiful skin. Visitors can enjoy strawberry picking, agricultural experiences, and a direct market.

name: 間山温泉
sales_point: 山ノ内町に程近い間山地区に位置する温泉地。北信五岳の雄大なパノラマを眺めながらの入浴は心身共にゆったりでき、宿は木の香に包まれるログコテージ。スキー場にも高速道路にも近い穴場的温泉。
sales_point_en: Located in the Miyama area, close to Yamanouchi Town, this hot spring offers a relaxing bath with a grand panorama of the Northern Shinshu Five Mountains, and the accommodations are cozy log cabins infused with the scent of wood. It is a hidden gem close to ski resorts and highways.

name: 丸池（志賀高原）
location: 長野県 下高井郡山ノ内町
sales_point: 上信越国立公園の中心、丸池に位置する温泉地。志賀高原内のバスルートの中継地で様々な自然探勝のコースへの出発点としても便利。
sales_point_en: Located at Maruike in the center of the Joshinetsu National Park, this hot spring is a convenient relay point on the bus route within Shiga Kogen, serving as a starting point for various nature exploration courses.

name: 美麻温泉
sales_point: 鹿島槍ヶ岳東方の美麻村に位置する温泉地。上尻川上流沿いにあり、四季折々の自然が旅人の心を慰めてくれる風情のある宿。
sales_point_en: Situated in Miasa Village, east of Kashimayari Mountain, this hot spring is located along the upper reaches of the Ueshiro River, offering a charming accommodation that comforts travelers with the beauty of nature throughout the seasons.

name: みどり湖温泉
sales_point: みどり湖畔に位置する温泉地。雑木林に囲まれ、自然環境が良い。特産のブドウやワイン、また川魚や山菜料理を楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: Located by the shores of Midori Lake, this hot spring is surrounded by a mixed forest, providing a good natural environment. Visitors can enjoy local specialties such as grapes, wine, river fish, and mountain vegetable dishes.

name: みのわ温泉
location: 長野県 上伊那郡箕輪町
sales_point: 駒ヶ岳に連なる桑沢山麓に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり眺望が良い。南アルプスや蓼科山、霧ヶ峰などの夕暮れ時の風景は美しい。
sales_point_en: Located at the foothills of Kuwasawa Mountain, which is connected to Mount Komagatake, this hot spring is in a quiet environment with great views. The sunset scenery over the Southern Alps, Tateshina Mountain, and Kirigamine is particularly beautiful.

name: 望月温泉
sales_point: 旧中山道の宿場町、望月町に位置する温泉地。薬用人参が特産品。南アルプスの眺望が良い。望月観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located in the post town of Mochizuki on the old Nakayama Road, this hot spring is known for its specialty medicinal ginseng and offers great views of the Southern Alps, making it a suitable base for sightseeing in Mochizuki.

name: 森温泉
sales_point: アンズの里として知られる森地区の入口に位置する温泉地。4月中旬頃に10万本のアンズに花が咲き見事。
sales_point_en: Located at the entrance of the Mori area, known as the land of apricots, this hot spring is spectacular when the 100,000 apricot trees bloom around mid-April.

name: 屋敷（秋山郷）
location: 長野県 下水内郡栄村
sales_point: 苗場山の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。秋山郷の中にあり、秋山郷探勝や鳥甲山登山に好適。秋山郷唯一の硫黄を含む(硫化水素型)療養泉です。時に変化する色、湯の香り、湯花をお楽しみ頂けます。温泉療養指導士が常駐しており、温泉など入浴方法の書籍も取り揃えております。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of Mount Naeba. It is situated within Akiyamago, making it ideal for exploring Akiyamago and climbing Mount Torikakuyama. The only sulfur-containing (hydrogen sulfide type) therapeutic spring in Akiyamago. Enjoy the changing colors, aroma, and hot spring flowers. A hot spring therapy instructor is on-site, and books on bathing methods are available.

name: 八ケ岳温泉
location: 長野県 諏訪郡原村
sales_point: 阿弥陀岳山麓、標高1300ﾒｰﾄﾙの高原に位置する温泉地。八ヶ岳の登山基地、諏訪湖観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 1300 meters on the foothills of Mount Amidadake. It is well-suited as a base for climbing Yatsugatake and for sightseeing around Lake Suwa.

name: 山田（信州高山温泉郷）
location: 長野県 上高井郡高山村
sales_point: 松川の渓谷を見下ろす台地に位置する温泉地。三方を山に囲まれ、閑静な環境にある。市街地からも近いが、渓谷の中にあるので紅葉時は絶景を誇る。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a plateau overlooking the Matsukawa gorge. Surrounded by mountains on three sides, it offers a tranquil environment. Close to the city center, but nestled in a gorge, it boasts breathtaking views during the autumn foliage season.

name: 八幡温泉
sales_point: 月の名所で知られる、おばすて田毎の月のすぐ近くに位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located very close to the famous moon-viewing spot, Obasute Tagoto no Tsuki.

name: ゆうすげ温泉
location: 長野県 北佐久郡軽井沢町
sales_point: 国道18号線沿いに位置する温泉地。国道沿いにありながら閑静な環境に恵まれている
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 18. Despite being along a national highway, it enjoys a quiet environment.

name: 湯川温泉
location: 長野県 木曽郡木曽町
sales_point: 御岳山東側山麓に位置する温泉地。御岳登山客の利用が多い。山頂に近い秘湯。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the eastern foothills of Mount Ontake. It is frequently used by climbers heading to Mount Ontake. A hidden hot spring close to the summit.

name: 湯川温泉
sales_point: 平尾富士の西側山麓、湯川のほとりに位置する温泉地。湯量が豊富。閑静な環境にあり保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of Hiraotofuji, by the banks of the Yukawa River. It has abundant hot spring water and is situated in a quiet environment, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 湯田中（湯田中渋温泉郷）
location: 長野県 下高井郡山ノ内町
sales_point: 湯田中渋温泉郷の玄関口で、夜間瀬川の高台に旅館やみやげ物店、飲食店などが街並みを形成する繁華な温泉地。
sales_point_en: The gateway to Yudanaka Shibu Onsen, this bustling hot spring area features ryokans, souvenir shops, and restaurants along the elevated banks of the Yakanese River.

name: 湯ノ沢温泉
location: 長野県 下水内郡栄村
spa_quality: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point: 上野原集落の公民館や和山集落の各家庭に配湯しています。ヒュッテひだまりやのよさの里で入浴することができます。キャンプ場も併設しているのでアウトドアも楽しめます。
spa_quality_en: カルシウム・ナトリウム－硫酸塩泉・塩化物泉
sales_point_en: Hot spring water is supplied to the community center in Uenohara and various homes in the Wayama community. You can bathe at the Hidamari hut and enjoy outdoor activities at the adjacent campsite.

name: 湯の瀬温泉
sales_point: 千曲川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。アユ、ハヤなどの旬の川魚が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the clear stream of the Chikuma River, where you can enjoy seasonal river fish such as sweetfish and dace.

name: 湯俣温泉
sales_point: 高瀬川の川畔に位置する山峡の温泉地。徒歩でしか入れない。登山者と湯治者によく利用される。
sales_point_en: A mountain hot spring area located by the Takase River. Accessible only on foot, it is frequently used by climbers and those seeking therapeutic baths.

name: 百合居温泉
location: 長野県 下水内郡栄村
spa_quality: 低張性アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point: 千曲川沿いの田んぼの中に建つ共同浴場。プレハブで見つけにくい場所にある。褐色の湯と油様臭が特徴的。
spa_quality_en: 低張性アルカリ性単純温泉
sales_point_en: A communal bathhouse located in the rice fields along the Chikuma River. It is somewhat difficult to find as it is in a prefab structure. Characterized by its brown water and oily scent.

name: よませ（北志賀高原）
location: 長野県 下高井郡山ノ内町
sales_point: よませスキー場内に位置する温泉地。スキー、ゴルフ、テニスなど四季を通じてスポーツを楽しむことができる。スポーツ後の疲れをいやすのに好適。山ノ内町の夕日鑑賞のスポットでもある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within the Yomase Ski Resort. It is ideal for enjoying sports year-round, including skiing, golf, and tennis. Perfect for relaxing after sports, it is also a great spot for sunset viewing in Yamanouchi.

name: 霊泉寺（丸子温泉郷）
sales_point: 霊泉寺川沿いの山間に位置する温泉地。丸子温泉郷のひとつとして数えられ、保養・静養に好適。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains along the Reisenji River. Counted as one of the Maruko Onsen, it is suitable for recuperation and relaxation. A designated national health resort.

name: 若栗温泉
location: 長野県 北安曇郡小谷村
sales_point: 白馬乗鞍高原スキー場のすぐ近くに位置する温泉地。白馬三山の眺望が素晴らしい。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located very close to the Hakuba Norikura Ski Resort, offering stunning views of the three mountains of Hakuba.

name: 蕨（信州高山温泉郷）
location: 長野県 上高井郡高山村
sales_point: 田園地帯に位置する温泉地。角間川の源流付近にある。北信の山々やアルプスが遠望できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a rural area near the source of the Kakuma River. You can enjoy distant views of the mountains of Northern Shinshu and the Alps.

name: 姫川温泉
location: 長野県／新潟県 北安曇郡小谷村／糸魚川市
sales_point: 新潟県との県境に位置する温泉地。姫川沿いにあり、落ち着いた雰囲気が漂う。日本海に近く海の幸山の幸が楽しめる。姫川のせせらぎを聞きながらゆっくりくつろげる。ヒスイ峡に遊ぶこともできる。
city_ja: 北安曇郡小谷村／糸魚川市
city_en: Otari Village, Kitaazumi District / Itoigawa City
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the border with Niigata Prefecture, along the Himekawa River, exuding a calm atmosphere. Close to the Sea of Japan, you can enjoy both seafood and mountain delicacies while relaxing to the sound of the Himekawa's babbling. You can also enjoy activities in the Jade Gorge.
